इसप्रकारदेखसकतेहैंकि:- 1. ​यदिएकमनुष्यअनुसंधानितवस्तुकोअध्ययनकरमूलव्यक्तिकेसदृश्यनहींहोसकताहै, तोयहस्वयंकेप्रतिविश्वासघातकाआधारहुआ।2. ​मनुष्यस्वयंअपनेसाथविश्वासघातकरलेताहै (वातावरणमें, नैसर्गिकताकेसाथविश्वासघातकरतेहीआयाहै।इसकाप्रमाणहै, नैसर्गिकता, वातावरणमेंअसंतुलनबढ़तेआया) जैसेमानव - मानवकेबीचअविश्वास, द्रोह, विद्रोहगहराना, शोषणप्रवृति, संग्रहरुपीप्रलोभनकाबढ़ना, परस्परसमुदायोंकेबीचशोषण, युद्घ, द्रोह, विद्रोहहीराजनीतिकाआधारहोना- येसबगवाहियाँहै।इससेकोईबेहतरीनसमाजरचनाअभीतकनहींहोपाईऔरनहीइसविधिसेहोपायेगी।इसकासिद्घांतयहीहैकिगलतियाँकितनीहीबारदुहराईजायेंउससेकोईसहीउत्तरनहींनिकलता।सकारात्मकविधिसेहरसहीकार्यकोकितनीहीबारदुहरायेंउसकापरिणामसहीऔरसार्थकसमाधानहीनिकलेगा।अबइससंसारमेंमानवसेपूछाजायेकि “आपसहीचाहतेहैयागलत?” तोहरव्यक्तिसहीकेपक्षमेंहीसहमतिप्रदानकरताहैं।साथहीसहीऔरगलतक्याहै? - यहपूछनेपरयहउत्तरनिकलताहैकिसहीगलतकासंक्रमणबिंदुयासीमारेखास्पष्टनहींहै।यहपूर्वर्तीदोनोंविचारधाराओंकेअनुसारप्राप्ततर्ककास्वरुपहैं।In this way, we can observe that: Betrayal of Self: If a person cannot truly embody the understanding or essence of the original discoverer by studying their findings, this becomes a foundation for self-betrayal. Betrayal of Nature and Naturalness: Humans have long betrayed not only themselves but also the environment and natural harmony. The evidence of this lies in the increasing imbalance visible in nature and human societies. Examples include: Mistrust among individuals, treacheries and revolts, The growing tendency for exploitation,temptation for hoarding and accumulation, sectarian conflicts becoming the foundation of politics. These are clear testimonies of such betrayal. This path has not led to the creation of a harmonious society, nor can it ever do so. The principle is simple: repeating mistakes, no matter how many times, will never yield the right answer. Conversely, any correct action, when repeated positively, will consistently lead to meaningful resolution. If we were to ask people today, “Do you desire the right or the wrong?” every individual would unanimously choose the right. However, if we ask them, “Do you know what is right and what is wrong?” their answer often reveals that the boundary or demarcation between the two is unclear. This ambiguity reflects the reasoning shaped by both the ideologies of the past. सहीऔरगलतकासंक्रमणबिन्दुअथवासीमारेखाजागृतमानवकोसमझमेंआताहै।जागृतमानवहीविकसितमानवहै।जागृतिकेलिएप्रयत्नशीलमानवहीविकासशीलमानवहैं।जागृतिकेलिएप्रयत्नशीलमानवकोअल्पजागृतवअर्धजागृतमानवजागृतिक्रमकोटिमेंपहचानाजासकताहै।जागृतिकाप्रमाणहै- अस्तित्वदर्शनअर्थात्सहअस्तित्वकेप्रतिपूर्णजागृतिअर्थात् :- 1. ​अस्तित्वकैसाहै, इसकासंपूर्णउत्तरजिसकेपासहो।

1. ​जोजीवनज्ञानअर्थात्चैतन्यस्वरुपकेअध्ययनमेंपारंगतहोऔरजिसकामानवीयआचरणवर्तमानमेंप्रमाणितहो, यहीजागृतव्यक्तिकास्वरुपहै।इसकामतलबयहीहुआकिजोजीवनकोभलेप्रकारसेजानतामानताहो; अस्तित्वकोभलेप्रकारसेजानतामानताहोऔरमानवीयतापूर्णआचरणअर्थात्स्वधन, स्वनारी, स्वपुरुषऔरदयापूर्णकार्य-व्यवहारकरताहो; तन, मन, धनरुपीअर्थकासदुपयोगएवंसुरक्षाकरताहो, संबंधोंकोपहचानताहो, मूल्योंकानिर्वाहकरताहो- यहीमूल्य, चरित्र, नैतिकतापूर्णमानवीयआचरणहै।The boundary between right and wrong becomes clear to an awakened human. Awakened humans are developed humans, while those striving for awakening are developing humans, recognised as partially awakened or half-awakened in the progression of awakening. The evidence of awakening lies in a complete understanding of existence as coexistence. This is defined as:

●​Having a comprehensive answer to the nature of existence. ●​Being proficient in the knowledge of jeevan through study and who evidences humane conduct in the present. Thus, an awakened human is someone who:

●​Thoroughly understands and believes in the nature of jeevan and existence. ●​Demonstrates humane conduct, which includes: ○​Living with righteous wealth, ○​Marital faithfulness, ○​Kindness in work and behaviour, ○​Ensuring the right use and protection of resources like body, mind, and wealth, ○​Recognising relationships and fulfilling the values inherent in them. This alignment of values, character, and ethics outlines the humane conduct. इसप्रकारजागृतमानवकास्वरुप, कार्यऔरप्रमाणस्पष्टहोजाताहै।यहमानवकुलमेंअध्ययनगम्यहोनाऔरव्यवहारिकहोनासहजहै।जागृतमानवपरंपराकाआधारभीइन्हींतीनतथ्योंकामानवपरंपरामेंहोनेमात्रसेहै।जीवनज्ञानऔरमानवीयतापूर्णआचरणज्ञानकेरूपमेंमानवीयताप्रमाणितहोतीहै।सहअस्तित्वदर्शनज्ञानसेवर्तमानरूपमेंविद्वत्ताप्रमाणितहोतीहै।जीवनज्ञानहीजीवनविद्याहै।अस्तित्वहीविद्वत्ताकीसंपूर्णवस्तुहै।मानवीयताहीसंपूर्णआचरणहैं।अखण्डसमाजहीविद्वत्तापूर्णमानवत्वकावैभवहै।सार्वभौमव्यवस्थाहीअस्तित्वमेंजागृतमानवकेअविभाज्यवर्तमानहोनेकाप्रमाणहै।मानवमेंस्वानुशासनहीजागृतिपूर्णताकाप्रमाणहै।इसप्रकारअच्छाईयोंमेंप्रमाणित, समर्थितमानवमेंधीरता, वीरता, उदारता, दया, कृपा, करुणासहजमानवीयस्वभावोंसेअनुप्राणित, अभिप्रेरितऔरजीता-जागतास्थितिमिलताहै।सही, न्याय, समाधान, अभ्युदयसंपन्नश्रेष्ठतममानवपरिवार, मानवसमाज, मानवव्यवस्थाकासहजवैभवहै।यहीविकसितपरिवारअर्थात्जागृतपरिवार, जागृतसमाजअथवाजागृतमानवअखण्डसमाजकेअर्थमेंसार्थकहोपाताहै।यहसमाधानात्मकभौतिकवादकीसार्थकताऔरउद्देश्यहै।Thus, the character, actions, and evidence of an awakened human become clear. These qualities naturally make such individuals studyable and practicable within

humankind. The tradition of awakened humans is rooted in these three facts being inherently present in the human lineage.

●​Humaneness is demonstrated through the knowledge of jeevan and the understanding of humane conduct. ●​The holistic perspective of coexistence validates wisdom in the present. ●​The knowledge of jeevan is itself Jeevan Vidya (the knowledge of life). ●​Existence is the entirety of wisdom, and humaneness constitutes the entirety of conduct. An undivided society is the epitome of humane wisdom. A universal system stands as evidence of the inseparable presence of an awakened human within existence. Self-discipline in humans is the hallmark of complete awakening. In this way, an awakened human embodies qualities such as fortitude, courage, generosity, kindness, grace, and compassion. These traits reflect the natural humane character, bringing life and inspiration to human relationships and actions. A human family guided by rightness, justice, resolution, and abhyudaya becomes the cornerstone of a humane society and a harmonious social order. Such a developed family realises its full potential in the form of an awakened, undivided society. This encapsulates the purpose and significance of Resolution Centred Materialism. जागृतिकेआधारपरहीमानवसंबंध, मूल्यऔरमूल्यांकनविधिसेन्यायकोप्रमाणितकरताहै।यहजागृतिकाप्रमाणहै।सहअस्तित्वमेंसंबधसहजवर्तमानहै, इसकोपहचानलेनाजागृतिहै।संबंधकोपहचाननेकाप्रमाणहीहैमूल्योंकानिर्वाहकरना।इससेयहसूत्रस्पष्टहोजाताहैकिमूल्योंकानिर्वाहकरनाजीवनसहजहैं।संबंधोंकोपहचाननामानवसहजहै।शरीरऔरजीवनकेसंयुक्तरूपमेंमानवहैं।मानवसहजरूपमेंजो-जोपहचानपाताहैउसीमेंजीवनशक्तियाँऔरबलअभिव्यक्तहोतेहैं।इसकाप्रमाणमानवइतिहासरुपीविभिन्नआयामोंमेंइसकेकार्यकलापोंकोस्मरणमेंलानेपरस्वयंस्पष्टहोताहै।जैसे-जैसेआदिकालसेमानवजिसवस्तुकोपहचानकरपाताथाउसीमेंमानवशक्तियाँअर्थात्आशा, विचार, इच्छारुपीशक्तियाँलगताहीरहाहै।इसेकिसीभीआयामकेसाथविचारकरदेखेंऔरवर्तमानमेंकिसीभीएकपहचानकेसाथअपनापरीक्षणकरदेखें।इसधरतीकेप्रत्येकमानवकोदेखेंतबहमयहीपातेहैकिजोसंबंधोंकोजैसापहचानलिएहैउसीमेंउसकीशक्तियाँबहतीहुईदिखाईदेतीहै।Humans establish evidence of justice through relationships, values, and methods of evaluation, all based on awakening. Justice itself is a testament to awakening. Relationships in coexistence are naturally present, and recognising them signifies awakening. The evidence of recognising relationships lies in the fulfilment of values. This clarifies the principle that the fulfilment of values arises naturally from jeevan, while the recognition of relationships is an inherent human trait. Humans, as a combination of body and jeevan, manifest jeevan's powers and forces in whatever they are able to recognise.

The evidence of this becomes apparent when we recall the various dimensions of human history. From antiquity, as humans recognised various entities, their jeevan powers—such as hope, thought, and desire—became directed towards these recognitions. This idea holds true across dimensions: in the present moment or by reflecting on historical experiences, we find that a person's jeevan powers flow into those relationships and entities they have recognised. Observing any individual on this earth confirms that the flow of their powers is shaped by how they have recognised their relationships. जैसेएकव्यक्तिअपनेबच्चेकोपहचानलियाउसस्थितिमेंममताववात्सल्यमूल्यअपनेआपबहताहै।उसीप्रकारजैसेस्वयंकेबच्चेकोपहचानेऔरममतावात्सल्यबहा, वैसेहीकिसीभीबच्चेकोपहचाननेकीस्थितिमेंवैसाहीममताऔरवात्सल्यकाबहनादेखनेकोमिलताहै।एकमित्रकाएकमित्रकेसाथसंबंधपूर्णतयापहचाननेकेउपरान्तपहचानतथानिर्वाहहोपाताहै।वैसेहीप्रत्येकमित्रकेसाथपहचानतथानिर्वाहहोपानास्वाभाविकहै।ऐसेहीगहराईसेदेखेंतोप्रत्येकव्यक्तिअपनेसम्मुखमित्रतासहितमुलाकातेंहोनेकीकामनाकरताहीहै।प्रत्येकव्यक्तिसेहरव्यक्तिविश्वासकीअपेक्षारखताहै, नकिअविश्वासकी।इसकाप्रमाणयहीहैकिअनजानदेश, अनजानव्यक्ति, अनजानभाषाआदिकीविपरीतताहोतेहुएभीएकदूसरेसेमिलनेकेलिएजबकोईव्यक्तिमानसिकताबनाताहै, तबसामनेवालाव्यक्तिविश्वासनिर्वाहकरनेमेंहीअधिकभरोसाकरताहै।इसीक्रममेंहरसंस्थामेंभागीदारीकरनेवालोंकीपरस्परतामेंविश्वासनिर्वाहहोनेकीइच्छाबनीरहतीहै।हरसमुदाय, हरदेशकीपरस्परतामेंभीविश्वासनिर्वाहकीनिश्चितरूपरेखाकेसाथनिर्वाहकरनेकीस्थितिमेंपरस्परमित्रराष्ट्र, मित्रसमुदायकहलातेहैं।अर्थात्परस्परनिश्चितअपेक्षाएँनिर्वाहहोनेकीस्थितिमेंयहपरस्परमित्रताकहलातीहैं।इसकानिश्चितन्यायबिन्दुयासार्वभौमन्यायबिन्दुमानवीयताऔरपांडित्यकेसाथहीप्रमाणितहोपाताहै।For instance, when a person recognises their child, the values of care and affection naturally flow. Similarly, the same values of care and affection can flow when recognising any child, not just one’s own. Likewise, a relationship between friends can be fulfilled when it is recognised. On deeper reflection, we find that every individual inherently wishes to meet others with friendliness. Every person seeks trust in their interactions, not mistrust. The evidence lies in situations where, despite differences in unfamiliar countries, among unknown people, or in the face of language barriers, when one decides to meet one another, they place greater trust in the other person’s ability to honour that trust. In the same manner, within any institution, the desire for mutual trust continues to exist among its participants. Communities or nations that adhere to definite guidelines of trust in their interactions are referred to as friendly communities or friendly nations. Thus, friendship arises when definite expectations are fulfilled in mutual relationships. The definite point of justice, or the universal justice point, becomes evident only through the combination of humaneness and wisdom.अस्तित्वसहजमानवमेंसमग्रअस्तित्वकेप्रतिविश्वास, वर्तमानकेप्रतिविश्वास, स्वयंकेप्रतिविश्वासहोना, संबंधोंकोपहचानना, मूल्योंकानिर्वाहकरना, मूल्यांकनकरनाबनजाताहै।यहजागृतमानवपरंपरामेंहीसर्वसुलभसर्वसाध्यहोपाताहै।समुदायपरंपराओंमेंयहसंभवनहींहोपाता।इसकाप्रमाणआजतककाबीताहुआइतिहासहै।

In humans who have attained effortlessness in existence, the following become possible: Trust in the entirety of existence, Trust in the present, Confidence in oneself, Recognition of relationships, Fulfilment of values, and The ability to perform evaluations. These attributes are universally accessible and achievable only within the framework of an awakened human tradition. Such outcomes are unattainable in sectarian traditions, as evidenced by the course of history till now. विश्वासमूलत: वर्तमानमेंनिष्ठाहीहै।निष्ठाकेफलमेंसमाधानहोनेकीस्थितिमेंउसकी (निष्ठाकी) निरंतरताहोनेकेलिएप्रयासबनारहताहै।वर्तमानमेंसमाधानव्यवस्थाकाहीप्रमाणहै।ऐसासर्वतोमुखीसमाधान, सार्वभौमव्यवस्थावअखण्डसमाजपरंपरामेंप्रमाणितहोताहै।सर्वतोमुखीसमाधानक्रममेंप्रत्येकमानवव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीकेरूपमेंप्रमाणितहोपाताहै।यहीप्रत्येकमानवमेंसमाधानकाप्रमाणहै।Trust, at its core, is dedication to the present. This dedication leads to resolution, which, in turn, fosters efforts for the continuity of dedication. Resolution in the present serves as evidence of existential orderliness. Such a comprehensive resolution is validated within the tradition of a universal system and an undivided society. In the process of achieving comprehensive resolution, each human demonstrates their role through participation in this orderliness. This participation itself stands as the evidence of resolution within every individual. रासायनिक-भौतिकवस्तुएँऔरजीवसंसारस्वयंमेंव्यवस्थासंपन्नहै।रासायनिक-भौतिकवस्तुएँपूरकता, उदात्तीकरणविधिसेअथवानियमसेव्यवस्थितरहनेकाप्रमाणनित्यप्रस्तुतकरतीहै।जिसमेंदृष्टरूपमेंमानवकाकोईयोगदाननहींहैक्योंकिजिसकिसीभीधरतीमेंमानवहोगा, उसकेअवतरणकेपहलेहीरासायनिक-भौतिकवैभवऔरजीवकोटिकाकार्यकलापविद्यमानरहाहैं।उक्ततीनोंपरंपराओंमेंव्यवस्थाऔरव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीस्पष्टहोचुकीहै।व्यवस्थाकातात्पर्यहैवर्तमानमेंवैभवहोना, परंपराकेरूपमेंअक्षुण्णहोना।मृत (मिट्टी), पाषाण, मणि, धातु, वनस्पति, जीव- येवर्तमानमेंअपनेवंशानुषंगीयबीजानुषंगीयऔरपरिणामानुषंगीयतासेवैभवितरहतेहै, परंपराकेरूपमेंअक्षुण्णरहतेहैं।Physicochemical entities and the animal world inherently possess orderliness. The physicochemical entities consistently present evidence of their orderliness through laws, complementarity, and the process of elevation. There is no perceptible human contribution to this orderliness, as the grandeur of physicochemical phenomena and the activities of the animal world existed long before humans appeared on any planet. These three traditions—physicochemical entities, the animal world, and their systems—are inherently orderly and participate in the overarching orderliness of existence. Orderliness implies both grandeur in the present and continuity as tradition. Soils, rocks, gems, metals, vegetation, and animals exemplify grandeur through their

result-conformance, seed-conformance, and species-conformance, respectively, while remaining intact as traditions. मानवअभीतकविभिन्नआयामोंकेइतिहाससहितघटनाक्रममेंव्यक्तहै।इतिहासमेंमानवजैसाजीतेरहाऔरवर्तमानमेंजीरहाहै, इसेदेखनेपरपताचलताहैकिसार्वभौमव्यवस्थाऔरव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीकेप्रमाणकोमानवप्रमाणितनहींकरपायाहै।फलस्वरुपअखण्डसमाजकेस्वरुपकासार्थकहोनाअपेक्षाकेहीरूपमेंरहगया।इसकामतलबयहीनिकलाकिमानवजातिअपनेढंगसेजैसेभीजीतीआईऔरवर्तमानमेंजैसीहैउसकेअनुसारमानवत्वकोनतोपहचानागयाहै, नहीउसेव्यवस्थाकारूपदियागयाहै, नहीइसेअखण्डसमाजकाआधारमानागयाहै।नमाननेकाप्रमाणहैशिक्षामेंमानवीयताकाअभाव, संस्कारपरंपरामेंमानवत्वतथामानवीयताकाअभाव, संविधानमेंमानवमूल्योंऔरमूल्यांकनकाअभाव, व्यवस्थामेंमानवत्वमानवीयतासंबंधऔरइसकेनिर्वाहोंकाअभाव।Humanity has, thus far, expressed itself across various dimensions as a succession of events in history. Observing how humans have lived in the past and continue to live in the present reveals that humanity has not been able to provide evidence of a universal system or its participation within it. Consequently, the actualisation of an undivided society has remained merely an expectation. This suggests that the way humankind has lived and continues to live has neither recognised humaneness, nor shaped it into a system, nor established it as the foundation of an undivided society. The evidence of this failure is apparent in the absence of human-ness in education, the absence of human-ness in the tradition of sanskar, the absence of values and evaluation in the Constitution, and the absence of humane relationships and their fulfilment in the existing system. राज्यकाअर्थसंस्कारऔरव्यवस्थासहजवैभवहै।धर्मकाअर्थसर्वतोमुखीसमाधानपूर्णज्ञानहीसंस्कारहै, शिक्षाबनामविद्वत्ताहै।मानवकासंपूर्णआधारमानवीयताहैयहसहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभवप्रमाणसहजविद्वत्ताहीहै।प्रमाणभीमानवीयताऔरविद्वत्ताहीहै।शिक्षाभीमानवीयताऔरविद्वत्ताहैं।संविधानभीमानवीयताऔरविद्वत्ताहै।व्यवस्थाभीमानवीयताऔरविद्वत्ताहै।इसप्रकारमानवीयतापूर्णपरंपरानित्यसमीचीनरहतेहुएनस्ल, रंग, रहस्यऔरवस्तुविभिन्नभाषा, पंथ, संप्रदायअहमतावशअर्थात्अतिव्याप्ति, अनाव्याप्ति, अव्याप्ति, दोषवशविद्वानऔरज्ञानीकहलानेवालेराज, धर्म, विज्ञान, स्वास्थ्य, कलाऔरसाहित्यशास्त्रियोंनेमानवपरंपराकेस्थानपरभ्रमितपरंपराकीअनुशंसाकरडाली, फलस्वरुपसंपूर्णप्रचारतंत्रहीभ्रमकेवशीभूतहोगया।इसीलिएबेहतरीनसमाजकीपरिकल्पनाहीउभरनपायी।बेहतरीनसमाजकातात्पर्यअखण्डसमाजहीहै।इसीभ्रमवश, मानवकावैभवप्रमाणितनहोपाया।जोकुछभीमानवकावर्तमानकहाजावेवहकेवलवंशवृद्घिहैअर्थात्जनसंख्यावृद्घिहीवर्तमानरहगयाहै।The meaning of governance is the grandeur of sanskar and systems. The meaning of dharma is comprehensive resolution, while sanskar refers to complete knowledge. Education represents learning, and the complete foundation of humanity is humaneness, which manifests as evidence of realisation in coexistence.

Evidence, too, is defined by humaneness and learning. Education is also a reflection of humaneness and learning. Constitutions embody humaneness and learning, and systems, too, are structured upon the same. Despite this, human tradition—rooted in humaneness—has remained obscured due to ego-driven divides based on race, colour, mystery, language, sects, or religions. Flaws such as excessiveness, deficiency, and omission have led so-called scholars of governance, religion, science, health, art, and literature to recommend a tradition of delusion in place of a humane tradition. As a result, the vision of a truly excellent society—a society that is undivided—has failed to materialise. This very delusion has prevented the grandeur of humanity from being evidenced. Consequently, humankind’s present condition has been reduced to nothing more than population growth, lacking any meaningful progress or fulfilment. मानवीयताअपनेस्वरुपमेंजीवनज्ञानसहितमानवीयतापूर्णआचरणहीहै।विद्वत्ताकास्वरुपअस्तित्वदर्शनहीहै।अस्तित्वकोसमझनाहीअर्थात्जानना, मानना, उसकीतृप्तिबिन्दुकाअनुभवकरनाहीदर्शनहै।मानवमेंपहलेबताईहुईदसक्रियाओंकेअविभाज्यवैभवकोजीवनज्ञानकहाहै।इसेस्वयंमेंपहचानना, जानना, माननाऔरउसकीतृप्तिबिंदुकाअनुभवकरनातथान्याय, धर्मबनामसर्वतोमुखीसमाधानसत्यबनामअनुभवऔरप्रामाणिकतापूर्णविधिसेअभिव्यक्त, संप्रेषितऔरप्रकाशितहोनाजीवनज्ञानकातात्पर्यहै।Humaneness, in its essence, is humane conduct integrated with the knowledge of jeevan. Learning is embodied in the holistic understanding of existence. To understand existence—i.e., to know, believe, and realise its point of fulfilment—is what defines this holistic view. The inseparable grandeur of the ten activities of jeevan within a human is referred to as the knowledge of jeevan. Recognising, knowing, and believing these activities within oneself, realising their point of fulfilment, and further expressing, communicating, and illuminating justice and dharma as comprehensive resolution, as well as truth in the form of realisation and authenticity, together constitute the meaning of the knowledge of jeevan. जीवनसहजकार्यकलापोंमें, सेबोधऔरअनुभवहैं।तृप्तिक्रममेंसहअस्तित्वसहजपदार्थावस्था, प्राणावस्था, जीवावस्थाएवंज्ञानावस्थायेसभीअवस्थाएँसत्तामेंसंपृक्तजड़-चैतन्यप्रकृतिकेरूपमेंनित्यविद्यमान, नित्यवर्तमानहै।इससहजसत्यकोजानना, माननाऔरतृप्तिबिंदुकाअनुभवकरना, उसकीनिरंतरताबनीहीरहना, उसकीअभिव्यक्ति, संप्रेषणाकोअध्ययनविधिसेसार्थकबनादेना, साथहीस्वानुशासनविधिसेजीनेकीकलाकोप्रमाणितकरनाहीदर्शनशास्त्रकासार्थकरूपहैं।Enlightenment and realisation are among the jeevan activities, contributing to its progression towards fulfilment. The material order, biological order, animal order, and knowledge order—all these orders of nature—are eternally present as aspects of the insentient and sentient nature saturated in Omnipotence. To know and believe this existential truth, to realise its point of fulfilment and ensure its continuity, to make its

expression, communication and exposition meaningful by way of study, and to substantiate the art of living through self-discipline—this constitutes the actualised essence of philosophical literature.सत्यबोधऔरअनुभवकेलिएदर्शककोज्ञानदृष्टिद्वाराहीदृश्यसमझमेंआताहै।समझमेंआनेकेमूलमेंजानना, माननाप्रक्रियाहै।जानने, माननेकासंयुक्तस्वरुपहीअनुभवबोधहैं।इसकीतृप्तिऔरअक्षुण्णताहीबोधसम्पन्नपरंपराहै।दृष्टापदकाप्रयोगबोधऔरअनुभवकेरूपमेंहीहोपाताहैं।इसकोदेखा, समझाऔरअनुभवकियागयाहै।बोधऔरअनुभव, सत्यसहजरूपमेंहीहोपाताहै।परमसत्यसहअस्तित्वहीहै।अस्तित्वसमग्रशाश्वतवर्तमानहै।अस्तित्वमेंइसधरतीमेंदिखनेवालीचारोंअवस्थाएँहैं।इसीकाप्रमाणहैकिइसधरतीपरयेचारोंअवस्थाएँस्वयंप्रमाणितहैं।अस्तित्वमेंहोनाहीकभीभी, कहींभीप्रमाणितहोनाहै।जैसेअभीहमदेखरहेहै, समझरहेहैचन्द्रमापरकोईजीव -जन्तु, वनस्पतिनहींहै।कालान्तरमेंवहाँयेसबहोनेकीसंभावनाबनीहै।सूर्यकोमानवज्ञानकेअनुसारसर्वाधिकतपेहुएबिंबकेरूपमेंपहचानाजाताहै।मानवकीकल्पनामेंयहभीआताहैकिकालान्तरमेंयहठंडाहोसकताहै- ऐसाभीसोचसकतेहैं।ऐसीस्थितिमेंइसधरतीकीस्थिति, गतिक्याहोगी, इससंदर्भमेंकल्पनाओंकोदौड़ायाजाताहै।सूर्ययदिठंडाहोगयातोउसकेपहलेतरल, ठोसरूपमेंपरिवर्तितहोगायहअवश्यंभावीहै।तबचन्द्रमाजैसीधरतीहोगई, यहमानाजासकताहै।अभीचन्द्रमामेंजैसाहमसोचतेहै, आशारखतेहै, किभविष्यमेंरस, उपरस, रासायनिकवैभववहाँसाकारहोसकताहै।उसीप्रकारसूर्यमेंभीऐसाहोसकताहैयहसोचाजासकताहै।मानवकीकल्पनाशीलतासीमितनहींहै, यहकितनीभीहोसकतीहै।मानवसहजकल्पनाशीलताअक्षयहैजबकिअस्तित्वस्वयंमेंव्यापकऔरअखण्डहै।अस्तित्वअनंतऔरव्यापकहै।देशकालसेमुक्तहैं।इसीआधारपरइसमेंदेशकालातीतमहिमाकाहोनाअवश्यंभावीरहताहै।यहदृष्टापदमानवमेंसहजसार्थकहोताहै।अस्तित्वमेंजागृतमानवहीदृष्टापदमेंहै।दृष्टा, दृश्य, दर्शनअविभाज्यहै, क्योंकिअस्तित्वमेंचारोंअवस्थाएँसत्तामेंअविभाज्यहै।जागृतमानवकाअस्तित्वमेंअविभाज्यप्रमाणितहोनाहीदृष्टापदकाप्रमाणहै।इसतथ्यकोध्यानमेंलानेपरबहुआयामीकार्यसहितमानवकीसमीक्षाउनकेकार्योंकेआधारपरस्पष्टहोजातीहै।The perceiver attains the understanding of perceivable reality only through the knowledge-perspective. At the root of understanding lies the process of knowing and believing. The combined form of knowing and believing constitutes the enlightenment of realisation. Its fulfilment and intactness signify an enlightened tradition. The perceiver status refers solely to enlightenment and realisation—this has been seen, understood, and realised. Enlightenment and realisation can only occur within the truth. Coexistence is the ultimate truth, and existence overall is perpetually present. On Earth, within existence, the four orders are evident. Their evidence lies in their self-evident presence on Earth. Being in existence means becoming evident anywhere and anytime. For instance, we currently observe no vegetation or living beings on the moon, but over time, the possibility of their emergence remains. The sun is recognised as the most heated object. Humans imagine that, with time, it could cool down. In such a state, the condition of the Earth would change—we can imagine and speculate about it. Before turning cold, the sun would necessarily transition through liquid and solid forms, eventually resembling the moon. Similarly,

the chemical grandeur that we anticipate manifesting on the moon could also occur on the sun. Human imaginativeness is inexhaustible, whereas existence is inherently omnipresent and indivisible. Existence is not limited to place or time. Humans express reality through words, enabling them to imagine places and times even if these are speculative. In this way, every human evidences their capacity for imaginativeness and their perceiver status. Existence is countless and omnipresent—beyond the constraints of place and time. This necessitates its magnificence as being beyond place and time. The perceiver status naturally actualises in humans. Only awakened humans attain the perceiver status within existence. The perceiver, the perceivable reality, and the holistic view are inseparable, as the four orders in Omnipotence are indivisible. The awakened human’s inseparability within existence itself evidences their perceiver status. Considering this fact, we can critique humans and their multidimensional expressions based on their actions. अस्तित्वनित्यवर्तमानहै, जागृतमानवदृष्टापदमेंहै; यहपरमसत्यहै, इसपरआधारितएकनजरियाहै।इसनजरिएसेविगतको, इतिहासकेढंगसेदेखनेपरपताचलताहैकिसभीपरंपराएँअपने-अपनेसमुदायअथवाव्यक्तिकेलिएअनेकानेकछल, बल, समोहन, प्रलोभनकरतीरहीऔरइससेपरेशानियाँबढ़ातारहा।इसकामूलकारणइतनाहीहैकिभ्रमितमानवसमुदायपरंपरामेंअपनेढंगसेभ्रमितरहकरभ्रमितपरंपराबनानेकेलिएजीवनकीशक्तियोंकोलगातेरहे।आदिकालसेहीमानवजीवनऔरशरीरकासंयुक्तसाकाररूपहै, जीवचेतनावशभयप्रलोभनरूपमेंजीवनशक्तियाँपहलेभीकामकरतीरहीहै, अभीभीकामकररहीहैं।इसआधारपरवर्तमानमेंभ्रम-निर्भ्रमसंबंधीपरीक्षणकरनेजातेहैतबपताचलताहैकि :- 1. ​मानवसर्वप्रथमकल्पनाओंकोभ्रमवशसत्यमानतारहाहै।2. ​भ्रमितविचारोंकेआधारपरसत्यमानलेताहै।3. ​भ्रमितइच्छाओंकेआधारपरसत्यमानलेताहै।4. ​सत्यबोधकेआधारपरसहअस्तित्वसमझमेंआताहै।5. ​सहअस्तित्वरूपीपरमसत्यमेंअनुभवकेआधारपरसत्यसमझताहै, प्रमाणितरहताहै।Existence is eternally present, and the awakened human resides in the perceiver status—this is the ultimate truth, which forms the basis of a worldview. From this perspective, when we examine the past or history, we observe that traditions, for their respective communities or individuals, have often employed deceit, force, illusions, and temptations, leading to increased troubles over time. The root cause of this lies in deluded human communities, which, being deluded in their own ways, have consistently channelled jeevan energies into sustaining deluded traditions. From the very beginning, humans have been a unified embodiment of jeevan and the body. Driven by animal consciousness, jeevan energies have operated in the forms of fear and incentives—both in the past and in the present.

When we examine the distinction between delusion and awakening in the current context, we find:

1.​Humans initially perceive imaginations as truth due to delusion. 2.​They then accept truth that is based on their deluded thoughts. 3.​Subsequently, they accept truth that is based on their deluded desires. 4.​It is only through enlightenment in truth that they begin to understand

coexistence. 5.​Through realisation of the ultimate truth in the form of coexistence, they come

to truly understand and remain evidenced in truth. इसचित्रणमेंमहत्वपूर्णतथ्ययहहैकिमानवमेंदसक्रियाएँबताईगईहै, जिनमेंसेपाँचक्रियाएँबलकेरूपमेंतथापाँचक्रियाएँशक्तिकेरूपमेंकार्यरतरहतीहैं।जागृतमानवमें, से, केलिएबलऔरशक्तिही, स्थितिऔरगतिकेरूपमेंप्रमाणितहोतेहैं।स्थितिऔरगतिअविभाज्यहै, इसकोस्वयंमेंऐसाअनुभवकियाजासकताहै, निरीक्षणकियाजासकताहै।मनोबलआस्वादन-चयनकेरूपमें, वृत्तिबलतुलन-विश्लेषणकेरूपमें, चित्तबलचिन्तन-चित्रणकेरूपमें, बुद्घिबलबोधवसंकल्पकेरूपमें, आत्मबलअनुभवप्रामाणिकताकेरूपमेंपहचाननेमेंआताहै।शक्तियाँक्रमश: मनशक्तिचयनकेरूपमें, वृत्तिशक्तिविश्लेषणकेरूपमें, चित्तशक्तिचित्रणकेरूपमें, बुद्घिशक्तिसंकल्पकेरूपमें, आत्मशक्तिप्रामाणिकताकेरूपमेंप्रमाणितहोपाताहै।There are ten activities of jeevan described here, in which five activities function in the form of strength and five activities function in the form of power. An awakened human has strength and power of jeevan becoming evident in the form of state and motion. State and motion are inseparable, which can be observed and realised within oneself. The strength of mun gets recognised in the form of taste and selection activities, the strength of vritti gets recognised in the form of deliberation and analysis, the strength of chitta gets recognised in the form of contemplation and visualisation activities, the strength of buddhi gets recognised in the form of enlightenment and resolve, the strength of atma gets recognised in the form of realisation and authenticity activities. The power of mun becomes evident in the form of selection, the power of vritti becomes evident in the form of analysis, the power of chitta becomes evident in the form of visualisation, the power of buddhi becomes evident in the form of resolve, and the power of atma becomes evident in the form of authenticity. भ्रमितमानवकासामाजिकहोनेकाप्रश्नहीनहींहोता।अमानवहीपशुमानवऔरराक्षसमानवकेरूपमेंव्याख्यायितहोतेहैं।राक्षसमानवक्रूरताप्रधानहोतेहैऔरपशुमानवदीनताप्रधानरहतेहै, येदोनोंअमानवीयकोटिमेंआतेहैं।इसीलिएअमानवीयपरंपरामेंअपराधोंकापनपनाहोताहीहै।अस्तु, सार्थकनिष्कर्षोंकोनिकालनेकीआवश्यकताअधिकांशलोगमहसूसकरतेहै।निष्कर्षकीओरकल्पना, विचार, इच्छाओंकोदौड़ानेपरपरंपराओंकीनिरर्थकतासमझमेंआताहै।इसकेबदलेमेंक्याहो- यहसारबातहै।समाधानात्मकभौतिकवादनेनिर्णायकविधियोंकोपानेकेलिएविज्ञान, विवेकऔरज्ञानसम्मततर्कप्रणालीकोअपनाया।विज्ञानकातात्पर्यकालवादी, क्रियावादी, निर्णयवादीज्ञानसेहैं।विवेककातात्पर्यजीवनकाअमरत्वअर्थात्जीवनज्ञानसंपन्नता, शरीरकानश्वरत्वऔरव्यवहारकेनियमअर्थात् :- 1. ​बौद्घिकनियम

1. ​सामाजिकनियम3. ​प्राकृतिकनियमसेहै।A deluded human cannot truly be social. Non-humans are characterised as animalistic humans and demonic humans. Demonic humans are primarily driven by cruelty, while animalistic humans are primarily characterised by servility. Both belong to the non-human category. This is why inhumane traditions serve as breeding grounds for crimes. Consequently, most people feel the need to arrive at meaningful conclusions. When we analyse traditions with the intent of meaningful outcomes, their futility becomes evident. The crucial question then arises: what should replace them? This is the central matter. Resolution Centred Materialism has adopted a reasoning process grounded in science, wisdom, and knowledge to reach conclusions. Science refers to knowledge related to time, activities, and decision-making. Wisdom signifies the immortality of jeevan, mortality of body, and laws of behaviour - which are: -

1.​Intellectual laws 2.​Social laws 3.​Natural laws बौद्घिकनियमकातात्पर्य :- 1.​असंग्रहअर्थात्आवर्तनशीलअर्थव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारी।2.​स्नेहअर्थात्संबंधोंकोपहचाननेमें, मूल्योंकोनिर्वाहकरनेमेंविश्वास।3.​जीवनविद्यामेंपारंगतरहना, पांरगतहोनेमेंविश्वास, प्रतिभाऔरव्यक्तित्वमेंसामरस्यतासहजविश्वास।व्यवहारमेंसामाजिक, व्यवसायमेंस्वावलंबीहोनेमेंविश्वास।4. ​सरलताअर्थात्संबंधोंकोपहचाननेमेंविश्वासमूल्योंकोनिर्वाहकरनेमेंविश्वासऔरमूल्यांकनकरनेमेंविश्वास।5. ​अभयअर्थात्स्वयंमानवत्वसहितव्यवस्थाऔरसमग्रव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीहोनेमेंविश्वासहै।The meaning of intellectual laws: -

1.​Non-accumulation: Participation in the cyclical economic system. 2.​Affection: Trust in recognising relationships and upholding values. 3.​Learning: Trust in becoming adept in jeevan vidya, trust in the harmony of talent and

personality, trust in being social in behaviour, and trust in being self-reliant in vocation. 4.​Simplicity: Trust in recognising relationships, fulfilling values, and performing

evaluations. 5.​Fearlessness: Trust in embodying human-ness within oneself and participating in the

overall orderliness of existence. सामाजिकनियम :- 1. ​स्वधनअर्थात्प्रतिफल, पारितोषऔरपुरस्काररूपमेंप्राप्तधनसेहै।2. ​स्वनारीऔरस्वपुरुष-विवाहपूर्वकप्राप्तदापत्यसंबंध।3. ​दयापूर्णकार्य-व्यवहारअर्थात्अविकसितकेविकासमेंसहायकहोनेकासंपूर्णकार्यहै।

The Social Laws: -

1.​Righteous wealth, i.e. wealth obtained through remuneration, gift or award. 2.​Marital faithfulness, i.e. conjugal relationship. 3.​Kindness in work and behaviour, i.e. all the activities for being helpful in the

development of undeveloped. प्राकृतिकनियमचारसूत्रोंसेसंबंद्घहै :- 1. ​पूरकता, उपयोगिता, नियम, नियंत्रण, संतुलन2. ​उदात्तीकरण, संरक्षण3. ​विकासक्रम, विकास, जागृतिक्रम, जागृति4. ​त्वसहितव्यवस्थाऔरसमग्रव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीप्राकृतिकनियम :- अपनेस्वरुपमें, प्राकृतिकसंपदाकेसाथ, मानवकाअपनेकोनैसर्गिकसंबंधकेरूपमेंपहचानऔरपहचाननेमेंविश्वासहै, क्योंकिमानवकेलिएमानवेत्तरप्रकृतिनैसर्गिकहैऔरमानवेत्तरप्रकृतिकेलिएमानवनैसर्गिकहै।इसमेंपूरकताविधिकोनिर्वाहकरनाप्राकृतिकनियमहै।1. ​संतुलन :- प्राकृतिकसंपदाकोऋतुसंतुलनकेअर्थमेंसंरक्षितकरनावकरनेमेंविश्वास; असंतुलनकीस्थितिमें, संतुलितबनानेमेंविश्वास।प्राकृतिकसंपदाकोउसकीअभिवृद्घिकेअनुपातमेंसंतुलनकोध्यानमेंरखतेहुएउपयोग, सदुपयोगकरनेमेंविश्वास।2. ​संरक्षण :- धरती, जलवायु, वन, खनिजकोसंरक्षितकरनेमेंविश्वास।3. ​मूल्यांकन :- प्राकृतिकऐश्वर्यकोउपयोगिताकेआधारपरमूल्यांकनकरनेमेंविश्वास।उक्ततीनोंनियमों (बौद्घिक, सामाजिक, प्राकृतिकनियम) मेंइंगितव्यावहारिकप्रमाणोंकेआधारपरमानव, मानवीयसमाजरचनामेंअर्थात्अखण्डसमाजरचनाकार्यमेंसफलहोताहै।The Natural Laws are under four headings: -

1.​Complementarity, Usefulness, Law, Regulation, Balance. 2.​Elevation, Protection 3.​Development Progression, Development, Awakening Progression,

Awakening. 4.​Inherent orderliness and participation in overall orderliness. The natural laws are in the form of confidence in recognising relationships with natural treasure, because the rest of nature is the naturalness for humans and humans are the naturalness for the rest of nature.

1.​Balance: - Confidence in protecting the natural treasure for climatic balance;

and confidence in making it balanced in the condition of imbalance. Confidence in use and right-use of natural treasure in proportion of its regeneration. 2.​Evaluation: - Confidence in performing evaluation of natural treasure on the

basis of its usefulness.

Humans become successful in formation of undivided society on the basis of evidence in behaviour indicated by the three laws above (intellectual, social and natural). इसधरतीपरभौतिकक्रियाकलाप, रासायनिकक्रियाकलापोंकेलिए; रासायनिकक्रियाकलाप, भौतिकक्रियाकलापोंकेलिएपूरकहै, यहस्पष्टहै।उदात्तीकरणसिद्घांतकाप्रमाणवर्तमानमेंहीदेखनेकोमिलताहैकिविभिन्नदोप्रजातिकेदोभौतिकध्रुवजैसेएकजलनेवाला - एकजलानेवालायौगिकविधिसेपानीमेंइसधरतीपरअम्लमें, क्षारमेंएकसेअधिकभौतिकतत्वमिलकरतरंगयातहोतेहैं।इनकासंगीतविधिसेवर्तमानरहनादेखनेकोमिलताहैं।यहीउदात्तीकरणकाप्रमाणहैं।ऐसारासायनिकवैभवक्रममेंअनेकप्रकारकेरसवैभवठोस, तरलऔरविरलरूपमेंभीफैलादिखताहै।जैसे, पानीठोसरूपमेंबर्फ, तरलरूपमेंपानीदिखताहीहैऔरवाष्परूपमेंअर्थात्विरलरूपमेंभापरहताहै।इसीप्रकारसेसंपूर्णरसऔरमिश्रितरसहोनाभीपायाजाताहै।अस्तित्वमेंयहउदात्तीक्रमअपनेआपमेंआनुपातिकहोताहैं।इसकातात्पर्ययहहैकि, इसधरतीपरसभीरसायनद्रव्यकाहोना, प्रत्येकप्रजातिकारसायनद्रव्यकितनेअनुपातमेंतैयारहोनाहै, इसपूरकविधिक्रममेंस्पष्टहुआ।पूरकविधिकीमूलवस्तुभौतिकवस्तुहीहैं।भौतिकवस्तुओंकामूलरूपपरमाणुहीहै।On Earth, physical activities are complementary to chemical activities, and chemical activities are complementary to physical activities. The evidence for the principle of elevation (Udatteekaran Siddhant) can be observed in the present itself: two physical elements—one that burns and another that supports burning—combine through a compound process to form water. Similarly, more than one physical element combines in acids and alkalis to create other chemicals, which are observed to coexist harmoniously. This coexistence serves as evidence for the principle of elevation. The splendour of chemicals manifests in various forms: solid, liquid, and gaseous. For instance, water exists as ice in its solid form, as liquid water, and as steam in its gaseous form. In a similar manner, all rasas (essences) and their combinations are found on Earth in specific proportions, governed by the principle of complementarity. The primary basis of this complementarity is physical substances, whose fundamental form is the atom. अस्तित्वमेंसंपूर्णरचनाएँचाहेकोईधरतीसंपूर्णरचनाओंकीरचनासेसमृद्घहोयाअसमृद्घहों, यहीदेखनेकोमिलताहैकिभौतिक-रासायनिकरचनाक्रममेंहीधरतीअपने-अपनेवातावरणसहितव्यक्तहोतेदिखाईपड़तीहैं।इनसबमेंपूरकताविधिसेसभीप्रजातिकेपरमाणुतैयारहोजातेहैं।भौतिकरचनाकीमूलसमृद्घिविभिन्नप्रजातिकेपरमाणुहैं।इनकेतैयारहोजानेसेपरमाणुओंकीप्रजातियाँपरमाणुमेंनिहितसंख्यात्मकअंशोंकेआधारपरस्पष्टहोतीहै, औरवर्तमानमेंप्रमाणितहै।जैसे- इसधरतीमेंजितनेभीप्रकारकेपरमाणुपरंपराकेरूपमेंस्थापितहोचुकेहै, वेसबपरस्परतामेंनैसिर्गकहै।ऐसाहोनेकेफलस्वरुपविभिन्नप्रजातिकेपरमाणुअणुकीस्थितिमें, अणुरचितपिण्डोंकीस्थितिमेंभीपरस्परप्रभावितकरनेवरहनेकीप्रक्रियाअनुस्यूतरूपमेंनिष्पन्नहोतेहीरहताहै।Whether a planet is enriched with all forms of compositions present in existence or not, it is through the process of physicochemical composition that a planet manifests along with its environment. On all planets, atoms of all types are formed by way of complementarity. The richness of a physical composition lies in the variety of atoms it contains. These atomic types are determined by the number of particles inherent

in their constitution, which are evident and verifiable in the present. For instance, all the types of atoms established on Earth as tradition surround one another in their mutuality. Consequently, there is a continuous and inherent process where various types of atoms transition into molecules, which further organise into molecular compositions.विभिन्नपरमाणुऔरअणुओंकापरस्परतामेंप्रतिबिम्बितरहनातथाप्रभावोंसेप्रभावितहोनाप्रमाणितहै।येसभीप्रकारकेप्रभावउष्माऔरगतिकेरूपमेंप्रमाणितहोजातेहै, क्योंकियहधरतीस्वयंउष्माऔरगतिकेरूपमेंहीस्पष्टहै।इसधरतीनेअपनेमेंजोवातावरणबनायाहैअर्थात्इसधरतीकीसहजभौतिक-रासायनिकवस्तुएँ, विरलरूपमेंभीइसीधरतीकेसभीओरफैलीदिखाईपड़तीहै।इसफैलेहुएव्यवस्थाक्रमसेयहतथ्यउजागरहोताहैकिब्रह्माण्डीयअथवाअनन्तसौरव्यूहकीउष्मा, प्रसारणकिरण-विकिरणसहजसंयोगमें, यहधरतीभीप्रमाणितहै।इसधरतीकेवातावरणनेअपनेमेंसक्षमताकोस्थापितकियाहै।इसधरतीकेवातावरणसेप्रवेशितहोकर, इसधरतीतकअर्थात्ठोसभागतकपहुँचनेतकउष्माकिरण-विकिरणकोयहधरतीउपयोगविधिस्वरुपदेदेतीहै।जैसे- यहधरतीउष्माकोक्रमसेकिरणोंऔररश्मिक्रममें, पूरकताविधिसे, अपनेमेंपचजानेकीस्थितिकोबनायेरखतीहै, ताकिइसधरतीकास्वास्थ्यसदाबनारहसके।इसप्रकारधरतीका “संरक्षणवलय” हीइसधरतीकावातावरणहै।यहीइसधरतीकाप्रभावक्षेत्रभीहै।It is evident that various atoms and molecules reflect upon each other in mutual interaction and are influenced by one another’s effects. These interactions manifest as heat and motion, with this Earth itself being an expression of heat and motion. The environment that Earth has developed contains its physicochemical elements spread all around in a gaseous state. This reveals that Earth is a part of the cosmos and receives heat in the form of rays and radiation from countless solar systems. Earth’s atmosphere has established the capability to transform these rays and radiations into a usable form as they enter its atmosphere and progress towards its solid surface. Earth sustains the conditions to absorb and integrate the incoming heat through complementarity, ensuring the planet's health remains perpetually intact. Thus, Earth’s “protective shield” is its very atmosphere, which also serves as the field of its influence. प्रत्येकएकअपनेवातावरणसहितसंपूर्णहै।संपूर्णताकातात्पर्य, पूर्णताकेअर्थमेंभागीदारीहै।अस्तित्वमेंपरमाणुमेंगठनपूर्णता, क्रियापूर्णताऔरआचरणपूर्णताहीसंपूर्णताकाप्रयोजनहै।यहीमूलसिद्घांतपूरकताकोनिरंतरप्रमाणितकरताहै।ऐसापूरकताक्रमप्रवर्तनसहअस्तित्वसहजप्रभावविधिसेप्रकाशितहै।सहअस्तित्वसंपूर्णवस्तुओं, अनंतवस्तुओंकीपरस्परतामेंसंपन्नहोनेवालेक्रियाकलापोंकावैभवहैइसकामूलरूपसत्तामेंसंपृक्तभौतिक-रासायनिकऔरचैतन्यरूपीजीवनप्रकृतिकीसंयुक्तअभिव्यक्तिहैं।इनअभिव्यक्तियोंकासंयुक्तरूप, व्यापकसत्तामेंअनंतप्रकृतिकावर्तमानहोनारहनाहै, जोस्पष्टहोताहै।इसीआधारपरअर्थात्वर्तमानकेआधारपरसहअस्तित्वप्रमाणितहै।सहअस्तित्ववशहीअथवासहअस्तित्वही “पूरकता”, “उदात्तीकरण”, “त्वसहितव्यवस्था”, केरूपमेंवर्तमानहै।इसकोजानना, मानना, पहचानना, निर्वाहकरनामानवमें, से, केलिएसमाधानहै।Each one is a whole with its environment. Wholeness means participation towards completeness. The purpose of wholeness in existence is - constitutional

completeness, activity completeness and conduct completeness. This basic principle itself manifests complementarity continuously. This inclination for complementarity is the manifestation of the effect of coexistence. Coexistence is the grandeur of all the entities and the activities in their interrelationships, which at its root is physical, chemical and jeevan entities saturated in Omnipotence. The combined form of these manifestations is the presence of the countless nature in the omnipresent Omnipotence. It is on this basis, the coexistence is evident as “complementarity”, “elevation” and “inherent orderliness”. Knowing, believing, recognising and fulfilling it is resolution in, by, for humans. पूरकताकास्वरुपकईप्रकारसेदेखाजासकताहै।परमाणुओंमेंविविधसंख्यात्मकस्थितिहैही, ऐसीविविधताकेमूलमेंदोअंशोंकेपरमाणुओंकाअनुपातऔरसैकड़ोंअंशोंसेसंपन्नपरमाणुओंकाअनुपातस्वयंइसधरतीपरप्रमाणितहैं।सहअस्तित्वसहजफलनहीअनुपातीयताकाप्रमाणहैं।इसप्रकारपरमाणुप्रजातिउन-उनकाअनुपातसहजरूपमेंउसकीपरमावधिकाप्रमाणहीहै- उदात्तीकरणप्रक्रिया।जबकिसीधरतीमेंसभीप्रकारकेपरमाणुतैयारहोजातेहैअथवाकिसीएकधरतीमेंकितनेप्रकारकेपरमाणुओंकीआवश्यकतारहतीहै, इसकानिर्धारणभूखेपरमाणुवअजीर्णकीकतारमेंस्प्ष्टहोजाताहै।जबतकभूखेरहतेहै, तबतकअंशोंकीसंख्यामेंघट-बढ़होतीरहतीहैऔरअजीर्णकीपरमावधितकपरमाणुअपनीभूखमिटानेकेक्रममेंकार्यकरदेताहै।अजीर्णकेआरंभऔरपरमावधिकेबीचअंशोंकाक्षरणहोनापायाजाताहै।क्षरणहोतेरहताहै।इसीप्रक्रियामेंऔरनईसंख्यात्मक (नईकातात्पर्यजोबनेरहतेहै, उससेभिन्नसंख्यात्मक) परमाणुकेगठनहोनेकीएकसंभावनाबनीरहतीहै, औरभूखेपरमाणुमेंक्षरणितपरमाणुअंशोंकेसमाजानेकीएकसंभावनाबनीरहतीहै।इसीक्रममेंउदात्तीकरणबिंदुपर्यन्तआवश्यकीयपरमाणुओंकीप्रजातियाँस्थापितहोजातीहैं।किसीभीधरतीमेंभौतिकवस्तुओंकेसमृद्घहोनेकेउपरान्तहीभौतिकवस्तुएँरासायनिकक्रियाकलापमेंतत्परहोतेहैं।तबतकठोसवस्तुकाभीअपनास्वरुपसंपन्नहोजाताहै।फलस्वरुपरासायनिकद्रव्योंकावैभवठोस, तरल, विरलप्रक्रियासेवैभवितहोजाताहै।रासायनिकवस्तुकाठोसरचनाक्रममेंकोषाओंकीरचनाऔरप्राणसूत्रकास्वरुपरचनाहीरासायनिकवैभवकेमूलमेंएकऐतिहासिककार्यहैं।उसीबिंदुसेरासायनिकउर्मिववैभवकाइतिहासआरंभहोताहै।आरंभहोनेकामतलबउन-उनधरतीमेंआरंभहोनेसेअथवास्थापितहोनेसेहै।अस्तित्वमेंयेसभीक्रियाएँशाश्वतरूपमेंवर्तमानरहताहीहै।Complementarity can be observed in many forms. Atoms exhibit diversity in terms of the number of particles in their constitution—ranging from atoms with two particles to those with hundreds of particles — both of which are evident on this very Earth. The proportionality of these variations is validated by the coexistence inherent in their outcomes. In this manner, atomic types and their respective proportions naturally reach a final stage, and evidence the elevation process. When all types of atoms are formed on a planet—or when the necessary types of atoms become ready for a specific planet—these atomic types appear in the form of a sequence of hungry and overfull atoms. As long as the atoms remain hungry, there is a continual increase or decrease in the number of particles in their constitution until they reach their state of overfull. From the beginning of overfull to their maximum capacity, a process of particle decay occurs.

This process allows for the possibility of forming new atoms, different in constitution from the existing ones, and for hungry atoms to absorb decayed particles into their structure. Through this sequence, until the elevation point is reached, the required types of atoms become established. On any planet, it is only after it becomes enriched with physical entities that these entities become ready for chemical activities. By this stage, the solid substances take on their complete forms. Consequently, the grandeur of chemical substances emerges through solid, liquid, and gaseous processes. The formation of biological cells and prana sutra is one historic milestone from solidification processes of chemical entities. This marks the beginning of the history of chemical currents and grandeur. The term "beginning" here refers to their initiation and establishment on a particular planet. In existence, all these activities perpetually continue in their natural state. रासायनिक-भौतिकसंयुक्तवैभवक्रममेंसंपूर्णरचनाएँसाकारहोजाताहैऔरसाकारहै।इन्हींरचनाओंमेंजीवऔरमानवशरीररूपमेंभीस्थापितरहताहै, स्थापितहोताहै।यहविश्लेषणअस्तित्वसहजअभिव्यक्तिहैं।वर्तमानमेंअस्तित्वहीदृष्टरूपमानवमें, से, केलिएदर्शनकीसंपूर्णवस्तुहैं।दृष्टासहजप्रकृतिअपनेमेंचैतन्यइकाईकेस्वरुपमेंवर्तमानहै।चैतन्यरुपीजागृतजीवनहीदृष्टापदमेंबोधऔरअनुभवपूर्वक, अस्तित्वदर्शनऔरजीवनज्ञानकोव्यक्त, संप्रेषितऔरप्रकाशितकरपाताहै।जीवनजागृतिकेप्रमाणोंकोप्रस्तुतकरनेकेक्रममेंजीवनज्ञान, अस्तित्वदर्शनकीएकआवश्यकतानिर्मितहोजाताहै।यहआवश्यकताऔरअनिवार्यतासहअस्तित्वसूत्रमेंसमाहितरहताहै, सहअस्तित्वहृदयंगमहोताहै।हृदयंगमहोनेकातात्पर्यबोधअवधारणाकेरूपमेंजीवनआश्वस्तहोनेसेहैं।उसकीअभिव्यक्तिअर्थात्उनअवधारणाओंकीअभिव्यक्तिसहजप्रक्रियामेंविश्वासहोनाहीअध्ययनहै।ऐसाविश्वासजीवनमेंतभीहोपाताहै, जबमानवव्यवस्थामेंजीताहोऔरसमग्रव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीकीप्रक्रियाप्रकटरहताहै।अन्यथाभ्रमितरहनापायाजाताहै।अव्यवस्थाकेरूपमेंउसकाव्यक्तहोनाउसभ्रमकापरिणामहैं।In the integrated course of physicochemical grandeur, all compositions materialise and take form. Among these, the compositions also manifest as animal and human bodies. This analysis reflects the natural expression of existence. In the present, existence itself constitutes the complete basis for the worldview of humans. The perceiver exists as a sentient unit of nature. An awakened jeevan in the status of a perceiver—through enlightenment and realisation—can manifest, communicate, and exposition the holistic view of existence and the knowledge of jeevan. As evidence of the awakening of jeevan is presented, it naturally gives rise to a need for comprehending the knowledge of jeevan and the holistic view of existence. This need and its indispensability are inherently woven into the principle of coexistence, which leads to the internalisation of coexistence. Internalisation signifies jeevan becoming assured through definitive understanding and enlightenment. Trusting the expression of such definitive understanding is what is referred to as study.

This trust manifests in jeevan only when humans live within an orderly system and actively participate in the processes of universal orderliness. Otherwise, they remain in a state of delusion. The manifestation of disorderliness is a direct consequence of such delusion. अव्यवस्थामानवजातिकीपीड़ाकाहीस्वरुपहै, क्योंकिअव्यवस्थाकीसमझबराबरपीड़ाहै।मानवजबकभीभीपीड़ितहोताहै, उसकाअध्ययनकरनेपरपतालगताहैकिअव्यवस्थाकीसमझवशहीवहपीड़ितहुआरहताहै।व्यवस्थाकीअपेक्षामेंहीअव्यवस्थाकीसमझऔरपीड़ाप्रक्रियाबद्घरहताहै।इसकाव्यवहारिकरूप-एकआदमीकोज्वरहोनेकीस्थितिअव्यवस्थाहै, हाथपैरटूटनेकीस्थितिअव्यवस्थाहैं।वादविवादहोनेकीस्थितिअव्यवस्थाहैफलस्वरुपपीड़ाहै।वादविवादमानवमेंतभीप्रभावशीलहोताहैजबदोनोंपक्षगलतहोंअथवाएकपक्षअवश्यगलतहो।इसस्थितिमेंवादविवादहोपाताहै।दोनोंपक्षयदिसहीहों, उसस्थितिमेंवादविवादहोनेकीघटनानहींहोपाती।इसकेस्थानपरपरस्परविश्वास, समाधानकेप्रतिएकजुटनिष्ठाकाहोनापायाजाताहै।कुछआयामोंमेंइसकेप्रमाणस्थापितहोचुकेहैं।इसक्रममेंयहभीपतालगताहैकिवादविवादकेमूलमेंकमसेकमएकपक्षमेंगलतीरहतीहीहै।गलतीकामूलरूपभ्रमहीहै।भ्रमकाकार्यरुपअधिमूल्यन, अवमूल्यनऔरकिसीएकवस्तुकेस्थानपरदूसरीवस्तुसमझनाहीहै।इसकेउदाहरणस्वरुपसांपऔररस्सीकोदेखाजासकताहै।सांपकोरस्सीसमझनेयारस्सीकोसांपसमझनेसेइससेहोनेवालीपरेशानीस्वयंसिद्घहै।लोहाकोसोनासमझनाऔरसोनाकोलोहासमझनायहअधिमूल्यनऔरअवमूल्यनकीपरेशानीहैं।इसप्रकारइनतीनोंस्थितियोंमेंमानवगलतीकरताहीहै।स्वयंपरेशानरहताहै, फलस्वरुपवातावरणएवंनैसर्गिकतामेंपरेशानीपैदाकरताहै।क्योंकिजिसकेपासजोरहताहैउसकाबंटनकरताहै।इसप्रकारदेखनेपरयहभीतथ्यसमझमेंआताहैकिमानवकोदोहीस्थितिमेंदेखाजासकताहै- वहहैभ्रमऔरनिर्भ्रमस्थिति।Disorderliness is essentially the embodiment of suffering in humankind, as the understanding of disorderliness equates to pain. Whenever humans experience suffering, this suffering stems from their perception and understanding of disorderliness. The comprehension of disorderliness and its associated pain arises in the expectation of orderliness. This can be illustrated with practical examples: a fever is a state of disorderliness. Similarly, an argument is a state of disorderliness, which inevitably results in pain. Arguments arise only when both parties are in the wrong or when at least one party is mistaken. If both parties are correct, arguments do not occur. Instead, mutual trust and a collective commitment to resolution are observed. Evidence for this principle has already been established in some dimensions. Further examination reveals that at the root of every argument, there is invariably a mistake on at least one side. The fundamental cause of these mistakes is delusion. Delusion manifests as over-evaluation, under-evaluation, or mis-evaluation. For instance, mistaking a snake for a rope, or a rope for a snake, illustrates the problem of mis-evaluation. Similarly, mistaking iron for gold or gold for iron represents the challenges of over-evaluation and under-evaluation. In these three states of incorrect evaluation, humans are bound to make errors. These errors result in their own distress and, consequently, disturbances in their

environment and naturalness. This is because one can only distribute what one possesses. From this perspective, it becomes evident that humans exist in one of two states: delusion or awakening. भ्रमितमानवहीअव्यवस्थाकेरूपमेंप्रकाशितहोपाताहै।अव्यवस्थातीनउन्मादोंकेरूपमेंव्याख्यायितहोतीहैं।मानवमेंसम्मोहनात्मकउन्मादलाभोन्माद, कामोन्मादतथाभोगोन्मादकेरूपमेंसर्वेक्षितहोताहै।विरोधात्मकउन्मादद्रोह, विद्रोहऔरयुद्धकेरूपमेंसर्वेक्षितहै।इन्हींछ: प्रकारकेउन्मादोंकास्वरुपदिखाईपड़ताहै।इसकेप्रभावमेंकर्त्तासहितसभीअव्यवस्थाकेरूपमेंदिखाईपड़तेहै।अव्यवस्थामूलत: भ्रमहै।ऐसेसर्वेक्षणकोसंपन्नकरनातभीसंभवहै, जबमानवनिर्भ्रमहोऔरव्यवस्थाकास्वरुपतथाअधिकारकमसेकमएकमानवकेपासहो।मानवइतिहासकेअनुसारइसघटनाकीतीव्रप्रतीक्षारही।इसबातकोइसप्रकारसेसमझायाजासकताहैकिउन्मादितहोतेहुएभीमानवही, इनउन्मादोंकेपरिणामस्वरुपजोअव्यवस्थाएँहुई, उसकीसमझकेबराबरमेंपीड़ितभीहोतेआया।भलेहीयहसबमेंनहुआहोअधिकांशलोगोंमेंअव्यवस्थाकीपीड़ाहै।इससर्वेक्षणकेसाथयहभीदेखनेकोमिलताहैकिइनउन्मादोंकेलिएहमारीकला, शिक्षाऔरशासनरुपीव्यवस्थातंत्रसहायकहोगयाहै।विकल्पकेलिएकोईकल्पनाभीनहींरहीहैइसलिएविवशतापूर्वकइसेझेलनेकेअलावादूसरारास्तादिखतानहीं।इसीस्थितिमेंकराहतेहुएअधिकांशव्यक्तिइसधरतीपरपायेजातेहैं।The deluded human alone manifests as disorderliness. Disorderliness is expressed through three types of obsessions. Humans exhibit hypnotic obsessions in the form of profit-obsession, sex-obsession, and indulgence-obsession. Similarly, antagonistic obsessions manifest as treachery, revolt, and war. These six types of obsessions influence individuals such that everything, including the doer, appears disorderly. At its core, disorderliness is nothing but delusion. Such an analysis becomes possible only when humans are awakened, and at least one individual holds the vision and authority to establish orderliness. Human history reflects an intense anticipation for such an occurrence. This can be explained as follows: even while being driven by these obsessions, humans have suffered from the disorder they create to the extent of their understanding of it. While this may not apply to everyone, the majority of people experience the pain of disorderliness. This analysis also reveals that our systems—arts, education, and governance—have, in many ways, facilitated these obsessions. The lack of imagination for an alternative leaves humanity with no choice but to endure this state. Consequently, most individuals on this Earth are found to be struggling and suffering under such circumstances. पूर्वर्तीविचारोंकेअनुसारउक्तउन्मादोंकेविपरीतकोईचीजहैतोवहहैभक्तिऔरविरक्तिवादीनिबंध।येपावनग्रंथमानेगयेऔरइनकाप्रचारकरें।इसकीअंतिमपरिणतिकेरूपमेंमंदिर, मस्जिद, गुरुद्वारा, गिरिजाघरोंकेप्रतिअथवापूजास्थलोंकेप्रतिआस्थाकेन्द्रीभूतहुई।आस्थाकेआधारपरबहुतसारेविशिष्टलोगोंको, महापुरुषोंको, सामान्यजनोंनेअपनेआस्थासुमनअर्पितकिए।आजभीइसबातकोपरीक्षणकरदेखें, उन्मादोंकीतुलनामेंआस्थाएँराहतसीप्रतीतहोतीहै।इसबातकोपरीक्षणकरदेखागयाहै।इसकेबावजूदभक्तिऔरविरक्तिकाशिक्षा, व्यवस्था, संविधानऔरसंस्कारोंमेंसार्वभौमहोनासंभवनहींहुआ।

इसकेसाथयहभीदेखनेकोमिलाकिविज्ञानशिक्षाअवश्यहीसार्वभौमरूपमेंशिक्षाक्रममेंउतरआयापरयहयंत्रप्रमाणमेंअटकगया।यहविज्ञानशिक्षा, शिक्षाक्रममेंवैभवितहोतेहुएभीव्यवहारमेंसार्थकनहींहोपाया, जैसे- संस्कार, व्यवस्था, संविधानोंमेंऔरमानवसहजआचरणमेंसहायकयाप्रमाणितनहींहोपाया।इसमेंयहीतर्ककरसकतेहैकिशरीरशास्त्रियोंकेअनुसारमानवकोइससेसहायतामिलीहै।शरीरऔरस्वास्थ्यसंबंधीबातेंमानवसेहीआरंभितरहीं।इसमेंयहीअत्याधुनिकतकनीकी, यंत्रऔरतंत्रसहितकियेगयेप्रयासोंसेमानवकीऔसतआयुबढ़नाप्रमुखमुद्दानहींहै।इसकेउत्तरमें, अव्यवस्थामेंप्रभावितहोताहुआमानवदिखताहै।अव्यवस्थाकाप्रधानप्रभावतीनउन्मादसमोहनात्मकऔरतीनउन्मादविरोधात्मकपायाजाताहैजिसकाजिक्रऊपरकरचुकेहै।According to the preceding ideologies, if there is anything contrary to the aforementioned obsessions, it is the discourses on devotion and renunciation. These were considered holy scriptures and were widely propagated. This ultimately led to the establishment of places of worship—temples, mosques, gurdwaras, and churches—as centres of faith. On the basis of faith, ordinary people offered their reverence to certain distinguished individuals or great personalities. Even today, if this is examined, faith does appear to provide some relief when compared to obsessions. This has been tested. However, despite this, devotion and renunciation could not achieve universality in education, systems, constitutions, and sanskar. Alongside this, it was observed that while scientific education did become universal, it remained confined to instrumental evidence. Even though scientific education gained prominence, it could not meaningfully influence human behaviour—it did not become helpful or evident in sanskar, systems, constitutions, or natural human conduct. One could argue, as biologists do, that humans have benefited from scientific knowledge. Matters of the body and health, after all, begin with humans. Yet, the primary issue is not that technological advancements and scientific efforts, including modern tools and systems, have increased the average human lifespan. The real issue lies in the fact that humans continue to be affected by disorderliness. At its core, this disorderliness is driven by the three hypnotic obsessions and three antagonistic obsessions mentioned earlier. विकल्पकेस्वरुपमेंअर्थात्अव्यवस्थाकेविकल्पमें, व्यवस्थाहीहै।अस्तित्वमूलकमानवकेन्द्रितचिन्तनव्यवस्था- सार्वभौमव्यवस्था, अस्तित्वसहजव्यवस्था, सहअस्तित्वसहजव्यवस्था, रासायनिक-भौतिकरचनासहजव्यवस्था, विकाससहजव्यवस्था, जीवनसहजव्यवस्थाऔरजीवनजागृतिसहजव्यवस्थाकोस्पष्टकरताहै।इसकोअध्ययनगम्यकरानाहीसहअस्तित्ववादकाउद्देश्यहै। “सहअस्तित्ववाद” में“समाधानात्मकभौतिकवाद” एकप्रबंधहै।The alternative to disorderliness is orderliness itself, as envisioned through existence-based human-centric contemplation. This perspective elucidates various dimensions of orderliness: universal orderliness, orderliness of existence, orderliness of coexistence, orderliness of physicochemical composition, orderliness of development, orderliness of jeevan, and orderliness of jeevan’s awakening. The

objective of co-existentialism is to make these principles accessible for study. Within co-existentialism, Resolution Centred Materialism is a thesis. कुलमिलाकरव्यवस्थासूत्रोंकासम्मिलितनामहै- समाधान।इसीनामकावैभवरूपमानवमेंभीप्रमाणितहोताहै।इसकास्वरुपपूर्णताकेप्रतिसंपूर्णअवधारणाहै।अवधारणास्वयंदर्शनऔरज्ञानहीहै।दर्शन, प्रमाणीकरणमेंहीज्ञानसम्मतआचरणहैं।आचरणकावैभवव्यवस्थाहै।व्यवस्थासहजवैभवहीपरंपराहै।परंपरासहजवैभवस्वयंपूर्णताऔरउसकीनिरंतरताहै।In essence, the unified term for all principles of orderliness is resolution. Its grandeur is also evident in humans, manifesting as a definitive understanding of completeness. This understanding, in itself, constitutes a holistic view and knowledge. When this holistic view is realised, it expresses itself as conduct aligned with knowledge. The grandeur of such conduct is orderliness, the grandeur of orderliness is tradition, and the grandeur of tradition is completeness and its continuity within the self. भौतिकऔररासायनिकक्रियाकलापोंद्वारासहअस्तित्वसहजरूपमेंहीव्यवस्थाऔरसमाधानकोप्रकाशितकरनास्पष्टहुआहैं।संपूर्णवस्तुएँहीअपनाअविभाज्यतावशसहअस्तित्वरूपमेंस्पष्टहैजैसेअनन्तपरमाणु, अनंतअणु, अनंतरचनाऔरअनंतजीवनव्यापकसत्तामेंसंपृक्तहैं।अत: क्रियाशीलहै, “त्वसहितव्यवस्था” केरूपमेंसहअस्तित्वसहजवैभवितहै।इसक्रममेंमानवकेअतिरिक्तसंपूर्णप्रकृतिहीसहअस्तित्वमें “त्वसहितव्यवस्था” केरूपमेंव्याख्यायितहै।Orderliness and resolution are naturally evident by physical and chemical activities in the way of coexistence. All entities, by virtue of their indivisibility, are inherently evident in the form of coexistence. For instance, countless atoms, countless molecules, countless compositions, and countless jeevans are saturated into the omnipresent Omnipotence. Consequently, they are active and manifest as grandeur in the form of “inherent orderliness”. मानवसंस्कारानुषंगीव्यवस्थाहै।इसकेफलस्वरुपप्रत्येकमानवकोसमझदारीकेसाथजीनेकाहकबनताहै।परंतुसाथ-साथव्यवस्थाकोसमझनेकीजिमेदारीभीहै।समझदारीकास्रोतपरंपराहीहै।इसक्रममेंलाभोन्मादी, भोगोन्मादी, कामोन्मादीअध्ययनप्रबंधोंऔरउपक्रमोंकेस्थानपरविकल्पकेरूपमें“कामोन्मादीमनोविज्ञान” काविकल्प “मानवसंचेतनावादीमनोविज्ञान” भोगोन्मादीसमाजचेतनाअथवा“भोगोन्मादीसमाजशास्त्र” केस्थानपर “व्यवहारवादीसमाजशास्त्र” विकल्पहै।इसीप्रकार “लाभोन्मादीअर्थशास्त्र” केस्थानपर “आवर्तनशीलअर्थव्यवस्था” काविकल्पकेरूपमेंप्रतिष्ठितहोनास्वाभाविकरहाहै, क्योंकिउन्मादोंसेहोनेवालीपीड़ाओंसेअथवाउन्मादोंसेहोनेवालीअव्यवस्थाओंकीपीड़ासेअधिकांशमानवपीड़ितहोचुकेहैं।भ्रमसेबेहोशीकीओरजोघनीभूतहोंगे, वेहीइसपीड़ाकोनहींसमझपाएँगे, ऐसेलोगभीकमहीहोंगे।Humans are sanskar-conforming order. Therefore, every human has a right to live with understanding. Along with this, they have the responsibility of understanding the orderliness. The source of understanding is tradition. Consequently, in place of profit-obsessed economics, indulgence-obsessed sociology and sex-obsessed psychology, as alternative, cyclical economics, behavioural sociology, and psychology of humane consciousness have been proposed. Most people feel the

pain of disorderliness generated by these obsessions. While a few, lost in the haze of delusion, may remain indifferent to this pain, such individuals are in the minority.अस्तु, इनप्रबंधोंकोशिक्षामेंअपनालेनेसेशिक्षाकामानवीकरणसंभवहोसकेगा।ऐसेआवर्तनशीलअर्थचिंतन, व्यवहारवादीसमाजशास्त्रऔरमानवसंचेतनावादीमनोविज्ञानसहजऐश्वर्यसेसंपन्नहोनेकेलिएसमाधानात्मकभौतिकवाद, व्यवहारात्मकजनवादऔरअनुभवात्मकअध्यात्मवादकीआवश्यकता, अनिवार्यताहैही, जोपहलेस्पष्टकीजाचुकीहैं।येसबउपलब्धहोगएहैं।इनछ: प्रबंधोंकोपानेकेलिएअस्तित्वदर्शन, जीवनज्ञानऔरमानवीयतापूर्णआचरणकेप्रतिपादनसहजरूपमें, मध्यस्थदर्शनप्रतिपादितहुआहै।जोस्वयं “मानवव्यवहारदर्शन”, “मानवकर्मदर्शन”, “मानवअभ्यासदर्शन” और “मानवअनुभवदर्शन” कीअभिव्यक्तिहैं।इसदर्शनकेआधारपरवादऔरशास्त्रनिर्गमितहुआ।इसेमानवपरंपरामेंअर्पितकरनेकासंकल्पस्वयंप्रेरितहै।Therefore, by incorporating these treatises in education, the humanisation of education will become possible. There is a need and imperativeness of cyclical economics, behavioural sociology and psychology of humane consciousness for this. All these have become available. These treatises are based on Madhyasth Darshan - which postulates the holistic view of existence, knowledge of jeevan and humane conduct. Madhyasth Darshan has been expressed as “Holistic view of Human Behaviour”, “Holistic view of Human Actions”, “Holistic view of Practices in Humans” and “Holistic view of Realisation in Humans”. Based on this holistic view, the ideologies and treatises have emerged. The resolve to offer these to human tradition is spontaneous. इसअनुसंधानकेमूलमें, अव्यवस्थाकीसमझमेंजोपीड़ाएँथीं, उन्हेंदूरकरनाहीप्रधानकारणरहाहै।व्यवस्थासहअस्तित्वसहजअभिव्यक्तिहैं।यहअस्तित्वसहजरूपमेंहैं।अस्तित्वसदाहीसहअस्तित्वकेरूपमेंवर्तमानहै।सहअस्तित्वहीव्यवस्थाकेरूपमेंव्याख्यायितऔरव्यक्तहै।व्यवस्थाऔरउसकीअक्षुण्णताकेप्रतिमानवभ्रमितरहा, अत: मानवकापीड़ितरहनाअवश्यंभावीरहा।इसीलिएअव्यवस्थाकीसमझमानवकोआदिकालसेहीपीड़ाकेरूपमेंरहीहै।मानवव्यवस्थाकीआशाआकांक्षाकेआधारपरहीपरिवर्तनोंकोस्वीकारतेआयाहैं।मानवकाविभिन्नइतिहासइसबातकोउजागरकरताहै।At the root of this exploration lies the fundamental aim of alleviating the pain arising from the understanding of disorderliness. Orderliness is the natural expression of coexistence and is in the form of existence. Existence is forever present in the form of coexistence. Coexistence itself is expressed and manifest in the form of orderliness. Humans, however, have remained deluded regarding the essence and permanence of orderliness, making their suffering inevitable. Since ancient times, this understanding of disorderliness has been experienced as pain. It is this innate hope and aspiration for orderliness that has driven humans to embrace change. The diverse history of humankind testifies to this enduring pursuit. अभीइससमयमेंअथवाइससंघर्षयुगमेंमानवनेअपनेआपमेंसुविधाभोगकेलिएद्रोह, विद्रोह, शोषणऔरयुद्घकोनिश्चितऔजारमानलियाहै।आजकीस्थितिमेंसुविधाकीपरिभाषायहीदिखाईपड़रहीहै।मानवजातिजिसकोसुविधामानरहीहैउसकामूलध्रुवसंग्रहहै।संग्रहपरहीसुविधाऔरभोगटिकाहुआहै।यहपूर्णतयाशहरीजिंदगीमेंइसीप्रकारदिखाईपड़ताहै।शहरमेंअच्छीसड़कें, अच्छाघर, अच्छीगाड़ी, अच्छीदवाई, अच्छेखिलौनेऔरघरकेअंदरजितनेभीआधुनिक, अत्याधुनिकगृहशोभाऔरउपयोगीमानीगईचीजें, जैसे-फ्रिज, कूलर, वातानुकूलन, मिक्सी, ग्राइन्डरऔरछतकोसजानेकेलिएसभीइंतजामात,

चमकताहुआबाथरुम, बेडरुम, ड्रांइगरुमऔरकिचन, इन्हींप्राप्तसुविधाओंकोप्रमाणितकरनेकीस्थलीमानागयाहै।साथहीघरमेंमनोरंजनकेलिएटीवी, वीसीआर, रेडियो, फोटोग्राफिककैमरे, टेपरिकार्डरमानेगयेहैं।सुविधाजनकखुशहालीकीअभिव्यक्तिकैमरा, वीडियोकैमरा, बड़े-बड़ेएलबमहैं।इनकोउपलब्धिमानाजाताहै।इनसबसुविधाओंकोआदर्शमानकरप्राप्तकरलियागयाहै।In the present age of struggle, humans have come to regard treachery, revolt, exploitation, and war as definitive tools for attaining comfort and indulgence. This perspective shapes the prevailing definition of comfort. What humanity perceives as comfort is fundamentally rooted in accumulation. Comfort and indulgence are sustained by this principle of accumulation, a fact that is starkly evident in urban life. In cities, comfort is characterised by good roads, well-designed houses, luxurious cars, effective medicines, and a plethora of modern conveniences for home decoration and use, such as refrigerators, coolers, air-conditioning units, mixers, grinders, and decorative items for rooftops. Gleaming bathrooms, bedrooms, drawing rooms, and kitchens serve as testaments to these accumulated amenities. Additionally, televisions, video recorders, radios, cameras, and tape recorders are seen as essential for entertainment, while cameras, video cameras, and expansive photo albums are viewed as expressions of prosperity and comfort. These comforts are not only pursued but also upheld as ideals and achievements in modern life. जोलोगसरकारीसेवामेंअर्पितरहतेहै, उनकेअनुसारहमसेवाकुछभीकरें, जैसेभीकरें, अगरसेवानियंत्रणकानूनकेप्रतिकार्योंमेंवफादाररहसकें, तोकिसीभीकार्यकापरिणाम, उसकीजिम्मेदारी, किसीशासकीयअधिकारीएवंकर्मचारीपरनहो- यहीमुख्यरूपसेसुविधाजनकनौकरीकीप्रवृत्तिकार्यकरतीदिखाईपड़तीहै।Those in government service tend to believe that as long as their actions remain within the framework of service regulation laws, they bear no responsibility for the outcomes of their work. This mindset reflects the prevailing tendency to seek comfort and convenience in the job. व्यसनोंकेचंगुलमेंजोनहींहै, उनलोगोंकाआहारअल्पाहारजैसाहीहै।जोपर- पुरुष, पर-नारी, नशाखोरी, जुआखोरीऔरविविधप्रकारकेकृत्योंमेंलिप्तरहतेहै, उनलोगोंकेआहारकर्मकोदेखनेपरपतालगताहैकियेकुछज्यादाखातेहै।पहलेवालेआहारमेंरहनेवालेसादगीमेंरहनामानतेहैं।उससेभीअधिकसादगीमेंरहनेवालोंकोभीदेखागयाहै।कमसेकमघरकोचमकाएँरखें, कमसेकमखाएँऔरसामान्यरूपमेंकपड़ापहनें, टी.वी. रहतेहुएउचितकार्यक्रम, जिन्हेंवेपावनग्रंथरचितमानतेहै, ऐसेकार्यक्रमकोदेखतेहैं।इनमेंसेकोईसुविधावादीसरकारीसेवामेंभागीदारीनिर्वाहकरतेहुएदिखाईपड़तेहैं।ऐसेमेंसर्वाधिकसमानताजैसीकोईचीजहै, जैसाकुछऊपरचित्रणकियागयाहै, उनकावर्गीकरणकरनेपरयहस्पष्टबातदिखतीहै- 1. ​सुविधावादीव्यक्तिजोवस्तुओं, व्यसनोंमेंलिप्तहै।2. ​सुविधावादीव्यक्तिजोसुविधामेंलिप्तहै, व्यसनोंमेंलिप्तनहींहै।3. ​सुविधावादीव्यक्तिसंग्रहमेंलिप्तहै।4. ​सुविधावादीव्यक्तिवस्तुऔरव्यसनोंमेंअलिप्तरहनेकेरूपमेंदिखाईपड़तेहैं।

Those without any addictions tend to have light, minimalistic eating habits. In contrast, individuals engaged in behaviours such as adultery, substance abuse, gambling, and similar acts often display a tendency to overindulge in food. The former group considers their lifestyle as simple, while there are others who adopt an even more austere way of life—maintaining minimal home decoration, eating sparingly, wearing plain clothes, and watching only religious or spiritually inclined programmes on TV. Some from this category are also seen in comfortable government jobs. When analysing these varying tendencies, the following classifications emerge:

1.​The comfort-seeking individual engrossed in addictions. 2.​The comfort-seeking individual engrossed in comforts but not in addictions. 3.​The comfort-seeking individual engrossed in accumulation. 4.​The comfort-seeking individual disengaged from both accumulation and

addictions. आजकीस्थितिमेंव्यसनस्थलोंकोआकर्षक, सम्मोहकताविधिसे, लोगोंकोव्यसनीबनानेकेउद्देश्यसेअर्थात्कामोन्माद, भोगोन्मादकोजगानेकेलिए, तीव्रबनानेकेलिएसभीप्रकारकेसाधनऔरउपलब्धियाँलोगोंकेसम्मुखकरवाचुकेहैं।आजकीस्थितिमेंव्यसनव्यापारसर्वोपरिलाभोन्मादीव्यापारमानाजाताहै।कईदेशइसकोसंवैधानिकमानचुकेहैं।कुछदेशोंकासंविधानइसकीसंवैधताकोस्वीकारनेकीसोचरहेहैं।यहआजकीस्थितिहैं।व्यसनभीआजकेमानवकेलिएएकआदर्शसाबनचुकाहै।इसप्रकारसुविधावादीशहरीजीवनमेंव्यसनोंकीस्थापनाकोदेखागयाहैं।इसविधिसेअर्थात्सुविधावादीविधिसेकोईभीऐसास्थाननहींमिलाहैजहाँव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीहोनेकास्थितिरूपदिखाईपड़े।Today, addiction hubs are designed to be hypnotically enticing, aiming to draw people into addiction by presenting a plethora of means and facilities that ignite and amplify sex-obsession and indulgence-obsession. Addiction-related businesses are now regarded as the most profitable ventures. Several countries have already legalised these practices, and some others are in the process of considering their legalisation. This is the reality of the present time—addiction has even become a sort of ideal for many. Comfort-driven urban lifestyles are thus characterised by the institutionalisation of addiction. Through this approach, there appears to be no space for contributing to orderliness within the framework of comfort-seeking tendencies. सुविधाकेलिएसंपूर्णस्रोतयहधरतीहैं।धरतीसेप्राप्तपदार्थोंकोसुविधायोग्यबनाना, उसकीतकनीकीप्रक्रियाकेलिएप्रौद्योगिकीअभ्यासइसधरतीपरस्थापितहोचुकाहै।बहुतअधिकतादादमेंआजधरतीकीवस्तुओंकोसुविधायोग्यवस्तुओंमेंपरिवर्तितकरनाहै, ऐसीसभीवस्तुएँसभीमानवोंकोमिले, ऐसासोचनेपरआजकीस्थितिमेंजितनीसुविधाजनकवस्तुएँहै, येसभीवस्तुएँआजजितनीसंख्यामेंइसधरतीपरमानवहै, सबकोउतनीतादादमेंबनीवस्तुएँनहींमिलसकती।इसकेदोप्रधानकारणहै- 1. ​इसधरतीपरउतनीवस्तुएँनहींहै, जिससेहरव्यक्तिकोयाहरपरिवारकोउसकीकल्पनाकेअनुसारसुविधामिलसकें।इनकल्पनाकेअनुकूलवस्तुओंकोबनानेकेलिएआजजितनीप्रौद्योगिकीहै,

उससेकमसेकमअरबोंगुनाअधिकआवश्यकताबनतीहै।ऐसीअरबोंगुनाप्रौद्योगिकीकेलिएधरतीसेस्रोतपूराहोनासंभवनहीं।इसकेलिएयहधरतीछोटीपड़ेगी।इससेहोनेवालेप्रदूषणकोभीधरतीअपनेमेंसमानेकीस्थितिमेंनहींरहेगी।इसीलिएइसपरपुनर्विचारकरनाआवश्यकहै।2. ​सुविधा, संग्रह, भोगवादव्यवस्थाकासूत्रव्याख्याऔरप्रयोजनकाआधारनहींबनसकता।उक्तदोबिंदुओंमेंकेवलसुविधाकीराशिऔरव्यवस्थाकीझलकअथवाव्यवस्थाकीकसौटीमात्रसेहीनिष्कर्षनिकलताहै।इसकेअलावामानवनेधरतीकेसाथजोअत्याचारकियाहै, उसकेलिएअपराधकार्योंमेंपारंगतबनानेकाधंधाबनारखाहै, उसकेनिराकरणका, उसकेसमाधानकेलिएभीकोईनकोईउपायचाहिए।The ultimate source of all comforts is this Earth. Transforming the materials obtained from it into usable forms and the associated technological practices have been firmly established. However, maximising the conversion of Earth's resources into objects of convenience, with the intent to provide these objects to everyone, cannot result in a situation where all humans on this planet have access to the desired quantity of such objects. There are two primary reasons for this:

1.​The Earth simply does not possess enough materials to provide every

individual or family with comforts as per their imagination. To produce goods aligning with these expectations, we would require technology capable of outputting billions of times more than what is currently possible. Even then, Earth's resources would fall short, and the planet would be unable to absorb the resultant pollution. Hence, re-evaluating this paradigm is imperative. 2.​The principles of comfort, accumulation, and consumerism cannot serve as

the foundation for sustainable orderliness or as a meaningful basis for human purpose. For the two points above, we can derive conclusions only based on the quantity of amenities, glimpse of orderliness or the test of orderliness. Furthermore, the extensive damage humans have inflicted upon Earth—compounded by the institutionalisation of education systems that train individuals in exploitative practices—necessitates remedies and solutions to address these systemic issues. उपायकेरूपमें “समाधानात्मकभौतिकवाद” प्रस्तुतहै।इसदशककेकार्यरूपकेअनुसारसुविधावादीवस्तुएँजोभोगनेकेलिएआवश्यकमानलीगईहै, उसकेलिएजितनीवस्तुओंकोधरतीसेनिकालकरउपयोगकररहेहै, उससेभीअधिकवस्तुओंकोयुद्घसामग्रियोंकेरूपमेंपरिणतकररहेहैं।किसीदेशमेंइससमयजनसुविधाकेलिएवस्तुएँकीतादादकमहै, इससेअधिकयुद्घसामग्रीकेलिएउपयोगकरतेहोंगे।इनस्थितियोंपरनजरडालेंतबयहपताचलताहैकिधरतीमेंस्थितवन, खनिज, साधनअथवाद्रव्यकितनेदिनतकपूरापातेहैं।इनसबसेयहनिष्कर्षहमनिकालसकतेहैकिदो-एकपीढ़ीतकहीधरतीमेंयेसबद्रव्यपूरेपायेंगे।इससेहमेंज्ञातहोताहैकिभविष्यकीपीढ़ियोंकेसाथहमकितनाअपराधकररहेहै? खिलवाड़कररहेहैयामददकररहेहै? इसबातकाभीआंकलनआवश्यकहै।

“Resolution Centred Materialism” has been proposed as a viable solution. In the current decade, the extraction of Earth's resources has disproportionately leaned towards creating war materials rather than objects of comfort or public utility. Across nations, a larger share of resources is being diverted to war preparation than to amenities meant for the general population. This raises a critical question: how long can Earth's forests, minerals, resources, and raw materials sustain such patterns of exploitation? A realistic assessment reveals that these resources might last only one or two generations at best. This stark reality highlights the grave injustice we are committing against future generations. It compels us to reflect deeply: are we safeguarding their future or merely toying with it? Are we engaging in actions that perpetuate harm, or are we striving to provide meaningful assistance and a sustainable legacy? An urgent and honest evaluation of these questions is essential. “नैसर्गिकताकेसाथहमक्याकरें?” नैसर्गिकताकासंतुलनइसधरतीकेलिएऋतुमानकेरूपमेंप्राप्तहैं।इसकोहरमानवदेखपारहाहै।अस्तु, मानवकीस्वयंव्यवस्थाऔरसमग्रव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीआवश्यकहै।इसधरतीमेंऋतुसंतुलनकोध्यानमेंरखतेहुएमानवकेलिएजीनेकीकला, विचारशैलीऔरअनुभवबलकोविकसितकरनाअनिवार्यस्थितिबनचुकाहै।इसकाआधारहै “सहअस्तित्ववादप्रमाणितकरना।” सहअस्तित्ववादीविचारोंकेआधारपरहीअनुभवबलकोमानवव्यवहारमेंप्रमाणितकरसकताहै।साथहीव्यवस्थाऔरव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीकोप्रत्येकमानवव्यवहारमेंप्रमाणितकरसकताहै।तथासमाधान, समृद्घि, अभयऔरसहअस्तित्वकोवर्तमानमेंप्रमाणितकरसकताहै।यहीमानवकुलकाआशयऔरअपेक्षाभीरहाहै।“What should we do with our natural habitat?” The balance of the natural world is reflected in the rhythm of seasons, a phenomenon visible to everyone. Therefore, it is essential for humans to cultivate orderliness within themselves and participate in the overall orderliness of existence. It has become imperative for humanity to evolve its way of living, refine its thought processes, and strengthen its realisation while ensuring harmony with the climatic balance. The foundation for this lies in establishing evidence for co-existentialism. Through co-existential principles, humans can integrate realisation-based strength into their behaviour. This approach enables individuals to embody orderliness, contribute to the collective system, and evidence in the present the goals of resolution, prosperity, fearlessness, and coexistence. This has always been the underlying intent and expectation of humankind.

अध्याय - 7

Chapter-7

संचेतना, चेतनाऔरचैतन्य

Humane Consciousness, Consciousness and Sentient “समाधानात्मकभौतिकवाद” केविचारोंकाआधारसहअस्तित्वहीहै- यहस्पष्टकियाजाचुकाहैं।सहअस्तित्वमूलत: अस्तित्वहीहै, सहअस्तित्वहीअपनेसूत्रमेंवर्तमानएवंनित्यप्रभावीहैऔरशाश्वत्व्यवस्थाकेरूपमेंसहअस्तित्वहै।अस्तित्वनित्यवर्तमानहै।यहीसहअस्तित्वकानित्यवैभवहै- यहस्पष्टहोताहै।सहअस्तित्वकास्वरुपहै- सत्तामेंसंपृक्तजड़-चैतन्यप्रकृति, जोस्वयंपदार्थावस्था, प्राणावस्था, जीवावस्थाऔरज्ञानावस्थाकेरूपमेंइसीधरतीमेंस्थितमानवकोमानवमें, से, केलिएदिखाईपड़तीहै।इसमेंसेकिसीअवस्थाकोघटाकरयाबढ़ाकरसहअस्तित्वसहजसंपूर्णता, पूर्णताऔरउसकीनिरंतरताकीकल्पनाभीसंभवनहींहै।The basis of ideas of “Resolution Centred Materialism” is coexistence only - this has been explained. Coexistence is existence basically. Coexistence itself is present and eternally effective, and it is in the form of perpetual orderliness. Existence is eternally present. This is the eternal grandeur of coexistence. Coexistence is in the form of insentient and sentient nature saturated in Omnipotence - which is witnessed by humans on this Earth as material order, biological order, animal order and knowledge order. It is not possible to decrease or increase any order among these and imagine the wholeness, completeness and their continuity. The foundation of the ideas of "Resolution Centred Materialism" is coexistence—this has been clarified. Coexistence is, fundamentally, existence itself. It is inherently present, eternally active, and manifest as perpetual orderliness. Existence is ever-present. This is the eternal grandeur of coexistence. Coexistence is in the form of insentient and sentient nature saturated in Omnipotence. It is observed by humans on this Earth as the material order, biological order, animal order, and knowledge order. It is impossible to either reduce or increase any of these orders and still conceive of the innate wholeness, completeness, and continuity of coexistence. दर्शनऔरज्ञानहीदृष्टापदकाप्रमाणहैतथात्वसहितव्यवस्थाऔरव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारी, दृष्टापदसहितवैभवयहसंभावनामानवमेंसमीचीनहै।इससेअधिकज्ञान, दर्शनऔरआचरणकीआवश्यकतानिर्मितनहींहोपाती, इसमुद्देपरबुद्घिवादकेअनुसारइसेकैसेसमझाजायकिऔरअवस्थाएँनिर्मितहोनेकीआशाकरनाक्योंबुराहै, इसप्रकारसेकुछअस्पष्टप्रश्नकियेजासकतेहैं।अस्पष्टप्रश्नइसीलिएहोजातेहैकिमानवकीआशा, आकांक्षाऔरअभिलाषाओंकीअंतिममंजिलहीहैसर्वतोमुखीसमाधानऔरप्रामाणिकता।यहीजीवनजागृतिकाप्रमाणहैं।जीवनकीअंतिमअभिलाषाजागृतिहै।मानवकीअंतिमअभिलाषासर्वतोमुखीसमाधानऔरप्रामाणिकताहै।समाधानसेजागृति, जागृतिसेसमाधानप्रमाणितहोनाहीमानवपरंपराकीसफलताहै।यहीसफलतामानवव्यवस्थाहैऔरसमग्रव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीकाप्रकाशनसूत्रहै।इससत्यताकोअथवासाक्ष्यकोस्पष्टकरदेताहैप्रामाणिकता, स्वानुशासनसहजअभिव्यक्तिशीर्षकोटि

कीजागृतिहै।यहभ्रममुक्तिकाप्रमाणहै।यहनिर्भ्रमताकासहजप्रमाणहै।इससेअधिकमानवमेंकल्पनाशीलताकी, विचारशीलताकी, इच्छाशीलताकीगतिऔरअपेक्षाबनतीहीनहींहैं।इसलिए, इसेअंतिमसार्थकपरंपरामेंनिरंतरवैभवहोनेयोग्यवस्तुकेरूपमेंस्वीकारनाएकआवश्यकताऔरअनिवार्यताहै, क्योंकिमानवशुभकोस्वीकारताहीहै, इसीलिएइसेस्वीकारकरनेकेलिएबाध्यभीहैं।The attainment of a holistic worldview and knowledge is itself evidence of the perceiver status of humans. Humans inherently have the close possibility of realising inherent orderliness and participating in the overall orderliness, which embodies the grandeur of the perceiver state. Beyond this, there arises no further need for additional knowledge, worldview, or conduct. Intellectuals, however, may raise questions such as, “What is wrong with expecting further stages of nature's emergence?” Such questions often remain ambiguous because the ultimate destination of human hopes, aspirations, and desires is comprehensive resolution and authenticity. This, in itself, serves as evidence of jeevan’s awakening. The ultimate aspiration of jeevan is awakening, just as the ultimate desire of humans is resolution and authenticity. The success of human tradition lies in the mutual validation of resolution and awakening—resolution fostering awakening, and awakening substantiating resolution. This success constitutes human orderliness and illuminates the path for participation in overall orderliness. Authenticity clarifies this truth: self-expression grounded in self-regulation represents a high level of awakening. This is the evidence of liberation from delusion and the natural evidence of absence of delusion. Beyond this, no further progress and expectation in imagination, thought, or desire of humans. Thus, accepting this as worthy of eternal grandeur becomes both a necessity and an imperative. Humans naturally gravitate towards the good and, therefore, are compelled to embrace it. जीवनज्ञान, अस्तित्वदर्शनज्ञानएवंमानीवयतापूर्णआचरणज्ञानहीजागृतिऔरउसकेवैभवकास्वरुपहै।मानवकासहजशरणमानवत्वहीहै।प्रत्येकमानवइसबातको, अपनेमेंहीपरीक्षणकरसकताहैकिमानवत्वकिसप्रकारसेत्राणऔरप्राणहैं।इसपरीक्षणसेयहपतालगाहैकिमानवत्व (मानवमें, से, केलिएव्यवस्थासूत्र) हीजीवनत्राणकास्वरुपहैं।दूसरीभाषामेंजागृतिसहजजीवनबलकास्वरुपहैं।समाधान, समृद्घि, अभय, सहअस्तित्वइसप्रेरणाकास्वरुपहैं।इसढंगसेमानवत्वकीप्रेरकताऔरकारकताअथवात्राणस्पष्टहोताहै।त्राणसेहीप्रेरणायेंबलवतीऔरफलवतीहोतीहैं।प्रेरणाओंकोफलवतीहोनाहीत्राणकीतृप्तिहै।इसप्रकारत्राणऔरप्राण, पूरकताविधिसेकार्यकरतेहुए, यहप्रमाणस्वयंमें, स्वयंसे, स्वयंकेलिएप्रमाणितहोताहै।यहीजीवनसहजदसोंक्रियाओंमेंसामरस्यता, समाधानऔरव्यवस्थाकाप्रमाणहैं।इसप्रकारसहअस्तित्वमेंजीवनकेसमाधानसहजरूपमेंप्रमाणितहोनेकीसंभावनास्पष्टहोतीहैऔरइसेप्रमाणितकरदेखागयाहै।The knowledge of jeevan, the holistic understanding of existence, and the knowledge of humane conduct together embody the essence of awakening and its grandeur.

Humans’ natural refuge lies in human-ness. Every human can examine within themselves how human-ness is both life and saviour. This examination reveals that human-ness—defined as the principle of orderliness in, by, and for humans—is the very essence of jeevan’s sustenance. In other words, awakening is the embodiment of jeevan’s inherent strength. Resolution, prosperity, fearlessness, and coexistence are expressions of this inspiration. This clarifies that human-ness is both the driving force and the sustainer of life. It is through the saviour-like role of humaneness that inspirations gain strength and bear fruit. In this way, life and its sustainer, working in mutual complementarity, are self-evident in, by, and for oneself. This provides evidence of coherence, resolution, and orderliness across the ten activities of jeevan. Thus, the possibility of jeevan’s resolution in coexistence becomes apparent, and this has been substantiated through experience. मानवमेंसमाधानपरंपराप्रामाणिकतापूर्णपरंपराहीवैभवहै।ऐसीसहजपरंपराक्रममेंप्रत्येकमानवऐसीपरंपरामेंअर्पितहोकर, जोएकव्यक्तिनेपरमज्ञान, परमदर्शनएवंपरमआचरणकियाहै, उसेसभीव्यक्तिपासकतेहै, आचरणकरसकतेहैं।इसीकेआधारपरमानवपरंपरामेंसमाधान, समृद्घि, अभय, सहअस्तित्वप्रमाणितहैं।सहअस्तित्वकोजोएकव्यक्तिप्रमाणितकरताहै, उसेप्रत्येकव्यक्तिप्रमाणितकरसकताहै।जोएकव्यक्ति “परम-त्रय” केआधारपरव्यवहारमेंसामाजिक, व्यवसायमेंस्वावलबनकोप्रमाणितकरताहै, उसेप्रत्येकव्यक्तिप्रमाणितकरसकताहै।जोएकव्यक्तिमेंस्वयंकेप्रतिविश्वास, श्रेष्ठताकेप्रतिसम्मान, प्रतिभाऔरव्यक्तित्वमेंसंतुलन, “परम-त्रय” केआधारपरप्रमाणितकरताहै, उसेप्रत्येकव्यक्तिप्रमाणितकरसकताहै।यहीमानवपरंपराकासंस्कारानुषंगीगरिमा, महिमाऔरवैभवहैं।In humankind, the tradition of resolution—rooted in authenticity—is its true grandeur. By aligning themselves with such a tradition, the ultimate knowledge, ultimate worldview, and ultimate conduct realised by one individual can be attained and practised by all. This forms the basis for evidencing resolution, prosperity, fearlessness, and coexistence within the human tradition. The coexistence evidenced by one individual can be evidenced by every individual. The sociality in behaviour and self-reliance in vocation demonstrated by one individual, based on the "ultimate triad" of knowledge, can be demonstrated by all. Similarly, the self-confidence, respect for excellence, and balance in talent and personality exemplified by one individual, grounded in the "ultimate triad," can also be exemplified by everyone. This is the dignity, magnificence, and grandeur rooted in the sanskar-conformance of the human tradition. अभीइसक्रममेंअर्थात्उपरोक्तकहेगयेक्रममें, अस्तित्वमेंकुछऔरअवस्थाजुड़करअथवापाँचवींअवस्थाजुड़करसर्वकल्याणमार्गप्रशस्तहोनेकीकल्पनाओंकोक्योंनहींकिया? इसकेउत्तरमेंइसबातकोस्पष्टकियाकि:-

1. ​प्रत्येकमानवजागृतहोनाचाहताहै।2. ​प्रत्येकमानवजागृतहोनेकेलिए “परम-त्रय” विधिकोअपनासकताहै।3. ​प्रत्येकव्यक्तिजागृतिऔरप्रामाणिकतापूर्वकहीव्यवस्थाहैऔरव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीकरसकताहै।4. ​प्रत्येकमानवमें “परम-त्रय” विधिसेजागृतिसमीचीनहै।इसलिएऔरकोईआगेअवस्थापैदाहोगी, उससमयमेंअर्थात्कल्पनातीतलंबेसमयकेबादसर्वशुभहोनेकादिनआवेगा, तबतकअपनीहविशपूरीकरलेवें।इसप्रकारकीमनोगतवादीविधिसेअपराधोंकोअपनानेको, इसेसवैधमाननेकीहठवादिताकोत्यागदेनाचाहिए।मानवीयतामेंसंक्रमितहोनाचाहिएऔरजागृतपरंपराकोस्थापितकरलेनाचाहिए।जिसमेंमानवीयतापूर्णशिक्षा, मानवीयतापूर्णसंविधान, परिवारमूलकस्वराज्यव्यवस्थाजिसमेंसबकीभागीदारीकोपालेनाहीसर्वशुभस्थितिका, गतिकाप्रमाणहैं।यहमानवकेलिएसमीचीनहै, इसीलिएमानवीयतामेंपरिवर्तितहोनेकीसहजसहमतिसर्वाधिकमानवमेंप्रस्तुतहैही।अभीतकअव्यवस्थापरआधारितशिक्षातथापरंपरासेछुटकारापानेकाविकल्पनहींरहाहै, इसीलिएसर्वाधिकमानवछटपटातेआयाहै।इसतरहजिसविकल्पकीतलाशथा, वहआचुकाहैऔरकिसीअवस्थाकेइंतजारकीआवश्यकतानहींहै।In the sequence described above, why hasn’t a fifth order emerged to pave the way for universal well-being? The response to this question clarifies:

1.​Every human aspires for awakening. 2.​Every human can adopt the “ultimate triad” to achieve awakening. 3.​Awakening and authenticity are prerequisites for orderliness, enabling

humans to participate in the overall orderliness. 4.​Awakening is accessible to every human through the “ultimate triad.”

Therefore, the intellectual stubbornness of imagining a future order that might emerge after an unimaginably long time to bring universal well-being—and using this notion as a justification for indulging in self-serving desires—must be abandoned. We should relinquish the tendency to legitimise crimes through such self-serving reasoning. Instead, we should transition to humaneness and establish an awakened tradition. This awakened tradition would encompass humane education, a humane constitution, and a family-based, self-organising system where universal participation becomes evident as the hallmark of well-being. This possibility is already within reach for humans. Hence, the majority of humans naturally consent to transitioning towards humaneness. So far, there has been no viable alternative to escape the disorderliness rooted in existing education and traditions, which is why most humans have been restless.
